question: For an A-1 diplomat visa applied for at an embassy under Case 1, which family members count as the immediate family who can also get the visa?
reference: The parents, spouse and child who reside in Korea together with the eligible diplomat, consular officer or other person with equivalent privileges.
answer: The immediate family members who can also get the visa are parents, spouse, and child residing in ROK together with the above applicants [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: A-1 Diplomat
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

- A member of consulate or diplomatic delegation of a foreign government approved by the Republic of Korea
- A person granted with the same level of diplomatic privileges and exemptions as diplomatic delegations in accordance with international agreements or practices
- Immediate family members of the above

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. A member of diplomatic delegation or consulate
- Diplomatic mission: a foreign relations service officer such as ambassador, minister, councilor and secretary
- Consular Mission: consular officers such as consul general and consul
2. Person granted with the same level of privileges and immunities with a diplomatic/consular mission in accordance with international agreements and treaties
- Secretary General or Deputy Secretary General of the UN, or Executive Director of the UN agencies
- Head of State, Cabinet member, head of legislature (including both heads of houses in a country with a bicameral system), member of foreign delegation to attend a meeting hosted by the government of ROK.
3. Immediate family members of the above applicants
- Parents, spouse, child residing in ROK together with the above applicants

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport(Laissez-passer, international organization passer, diplomatic passport), a photo in a standard format
② A document demonstrating your current employment status and overseas assignment, or an official letter of cooperation written by the Minister of Foreign Affairs of an applicant's country
③ A certificate of family relation and any documents proving family relationship for an accompanied family member

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry or multiple-entry visa, and you will be allowed to stay in Korea until the end of your assignment.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. Officials and conference attendees of an international organization located in Korea
2. Immediate family members of the above applicants.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport(Laissez-passer, international organization passer, diplomatic passport), a photo in a standard format
② A document demonstrating your current employment status and overseas assignment, or an official letter of cooperation written by the Minister of Foreign Affairs of an applicant's country
③ A certificate of family relation and any documents proving family relationship for an accompanied family member

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
If you want to work at the embassy/consulate of your country in Korea, you can apply for a multiple-entry visa. In this case, you will be allowed to stay in Korea until the end of your assignment. However, if you are just visiting Korea on a short-term assignment, you can apply for a single-entry visa. Please contact the Korean Embassy or Consulate General(s) in your country for more information.

### Embassy visa application — Case 3

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. Officials or conference attendees of an Inter-governmental organization in which the Republic of Korea is involved.
※ In accordance with the agreements, an eligible applicant is limited to Director of the International Vaccine Institute, Secretary General of Green Climate Fund and secretariat worker whose position is equivalent to P-5 or higher defined in the UN position category approved by the government of ROK
2. Immediate family members of the above applicants.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport(Laissez-passer, international organization passer, diplomatic passport), a photo in a standard format
② A document demonstrating your current employment status and overseas assignment, or an official letter of cooperation written by the Minister of Foreign Affairs of an applicant's country
③ A certificate of family relation and any documents proving family relationship for an accompanied family member

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
If you want to work at the embassy/consulate of your country in Korea, you can apply for a multiple-entry visa. In this case, you will be allowed to stay in Korea until the end of your assignment. However, if you are just visiting Korea on a short-term assignment, you can apply for a single-entry visa. Please contact the Korean Embassy or Consulate General(s) in your country for more information.

question: Under the visa-free entry scheme for foreign transfer passengers in the visa-free entry guide, what status and length of stay does a general transfer passenger get, and what conditions apply?
reference: Tourist/Transit (B-2) status for 72 hours. The passenger must be transferring through Incheon Airport and taking part in the Transit Tourism Program on the way to a third country or their home country, hold a transfer ticket, and stay in the Seoul Capital Area. Citizens of the countries that need visas to enter Jeju are excluded, and the guide marks this scheme as temporarily suspended due to COVID-19.
answer: A general transfer passenger is granted a Tourist/Transit (B-2) status with a period of stay of 72 hours [1, 2, 3]. The conditions for permission are possessing a transfer ticket and staying in the Seoul Capital Area for up to 72 hours [1, 2, 3].

passages.title: Visa guide: B-2-1 Tourist / Transit (General)
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Person who plans to visit Korea for tour or transit without a visa

#### Visa Free Entry Guide
Visa is a fundamental requirement to enter the Republic of Korea, and in principle, foreigners must have valid visas when they travel. However, those who fall under any of the following categories below are allowed to enter Korea without visas. (Article 7(2) of the Immigration Act)
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
Even if the foreigner has the valid visa or is subject to visa-free entry, he/she may be denied entry to the Republic of Korea if he's found inadmissible by an immigration officer at the port of entry.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)
### Visa Free Entry for foreign transfer passengers (* Temporarily Suspended due to COVID-19)

#### 1. Eligible applicants
-
Besides the passengers for transit mentioned above, those transferring through the Incheon Airport and taking part in the Transit Tourism Program on their way to a third country or the country of their nationality (hereinafter referred to as "general transfer passengers")
However, citizens of the 24 countries that need visas to enter Jeju island are not included (Syria, Sudan, Iran, Macedonia, Cuba, Republic Of Kosovo, Palestine, Afghanistan, Iraq, Nigeria, Ghana, Yemen, Gambia, Senegal, Bangladesh, Kyrgyzstan, Pakistan, Somalia, Uzbekistan, Nepal, Cameron, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Egypt).
-
Chinese group tourists who depart from China (Hongkong, Macao included) and enter Korea through the Incheon, Gimpo, Gimhae, Cheongju, Muan, *Yangyang, or Daegu airport to visit Jeju Island and stay in designated travel regions for up to 5 days (hereinafter referred to as "Jeju group transfer passenger").
When admitted through the Yangyang Airport, the entrants are allowed to stay for up to 10 days in the travel regions.

#### 2. Condition of Permission
-
General Transfer Passengers: Possessing a transfer ticket and staying in the Seoul Capital Area for up to 72 hours
-
Jeju Group Transfer Passengers: Your group is organized by a Korean travel agency participating in the Transit Tourism Program and a Chinese travel agency responsible applying for group tourist visas at Korean diplomatic missions in China, and you have a ticket for a domestic flight/ship to Jeju that is scheduled to depart within 5 days, or in the case of the Yangyang Airport, 10 days.

#### 3. Eligibility and Period for Stay
-
General Transfer Passengers: Tourist/Transit (B-2), 72 hours
-
Jeju Transfer Passengers: Tourist/Transit (B-2), 15 days

#### 4. Airport of Departure and Designated Travel Regions for Jeju Group Transfer Passengers
| Airport of Entry | Airport of Departure | Travel Regions |
| Entrant at Incheon International Airport | Incheon · Gimpo · Jeju · Yangyang International Airports | Seoul Capital Area(Seoul, Incheon, Gyeonggi-do),Gangwon-do |
| Entrant at Gimpo International Airport |
| Entrant at Gimhae International Airport | Gimhae · Incheon · Gimpo · Jeju International Airports | Busan, Daegu, Ulsan, Gyeongsang-do, Seoul Capital Area |
| Entrant at Yangyang International Airport | Yangyang · Incheon · Gimpo · Jeju International Airports |
| Entrant at Cheongju International Airport | Cheongju · Incheon · Gimpo · Jeju International Airports | Gangwon-do, Seoul Capital Area |
| Entrant at Muan International Airport | Muan · Incheon · Gimpo · Jeju International Airports | Daejeon, Sejong, Chungcheong-do, Seoul Capital Area |
| Entrant at Daegu International Airport | Daegu · Incheon · Gimpo · Jeju International Airports | Gwangju, Jeolla-do, Seoul Capital Area |

question: The B-2-2 Tourist/Transit (Jeju) guide says foreigners can enter Jeju without a visa. How long can they stay, where may they go, how must they arrive, and does anything else in the corpus change this?
reference: The guide allows a stay of 30 days, limited to Jeju, and requires arriving by a direct international flight or ship to Jeju; citizens of the listed restricted countries are excluded. However, a notice that took effect on February 4, 2020 temporarily suspended visa-free entry to Jeju for all foreign nationals.
answer: Foreign nationals entering ports and airports in Jeju for the purpose of Tourism/Transit, etc. are allowed to enter without a visa, except for countries not permitted to enter without a visa as announced by the Minister of Justice [1]. For "general transfer passengers" transferring through Incheon Airport and taking part in the Transit Tourism Program, they may stay in the Seoul Capital Area for up to 72 hours [1]. For "Jeju group transfer passengers" (Chinese group tourists departing from China including Hongkong and Macao), they may stay in designated travel regions for up to 5 days, or up to 10 days when admitted through the Yangyang Airport [1]. The designated travel regions for Jeju group transfer passengers depend on the airport of entry: - Incheon International Airport: Seoul Capital Area (Seoul, Incheon, Gyeonggi-do), Gangwon-do [1]. - Gimhae International Airport: Busan, Daegu, Ulsan, Gyeongsang-do, Seoul Capital Area [1]. - Cheongju International Airport: Gangwon-do, Seoul Capital Area [1]. - Muan International Airport: Daejeon, Sejong, Chungcheong-do, Seoul Capital Area [1]. - Daegu International Airport: Gwangju, Jeolla-do, Seoul Capital Area [1]. The corpus states that even if a foreigner has a valid visa or is subject to visa-free entry, they may be denied entry if found inadmissible by an immigration officer at the port of entry [1].

question: im chinese and my daughter (also chinese) married a korean guy 2 years ago, marriage is registered in both countries. can i get a multiple entry visa to visit her? how long is it good for and how long can i stay each time
reference: Yes. Under C-3-1 (Short-Term General) embassy Case 2, a parent of a foreign spouse who has kept the marriage with a Korean national for more than a year after registering it in both countries can get a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years, with stays of up to 90 days each time.
answer: You are eligible to apply for the F-6-1 Spouse of a Korean National visa if you are a person with valid marital status in Korea who plans to stay in Korea to continue your marriage [3]. For this visa, you can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years [3], and periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days [3].

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person with valid marital status in ROK who plans to stay in Korea to continue his/her marriage

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person with valid marital status in Korea, who plans to stay in Korea to continue your marriage

### Required documents
A. Basic Required Documents
1. Visa Application Form, passport, 2 photo in a standard format, fee

2. Credit Information Report

If you want to prove your Earned Income

question: A Chinese national is going to Korea briefly for market research and to sign a contract, and applies at the embassy for a C-3-4 business visitor visa under Case 1. What visa can they get and how long can they stay?
reference: Either a single-entry visa valid for 3 months, with stays of up to 90 days, or a double-entry visa valid for 6 months, with stays of up to 30 days.
answer: They can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months or a double-entry visa valid for 6 months [1]. For a single-entry visa, the period of stay will be granted for up to 90 days, and for a double-entry visa, it will be granted for 30 days [1].

citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Person who plans to engage in commercial activities such as market research, business meetings, consultation, signing a contract, or small-scale international trading or an APEC card holder visiting Korea without a visa

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

a person who plans to stay for a short period of time in ROK for the purposes of market research, liaison works, counseling, signing a contract, or installing/repairing/learning to operate an imported/exported machinery, or other similar reasons

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A document proving the purpose of your business such as a business invitation letter, a copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of Corporate Register

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months or a double-entry visa valid for 6 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days for a single-entry visa , and 30 days for a double-entry visa.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year,
if you have visited the ROK or any OECD member country for one time and with no criminal and illegal immigration records

□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years, if you are
1) A professional that requires a license recognized by a government such as doctor, lawyer, accountant, and others.
2) A faculty member positioned higher than an assistant professor at university (or vocational college), a teacher of elementary, middle, or high school
3) Famous artists, entertainers and athletes acknowledged by the head of Korean diplomatic mission abroad
4) A person who has visited ROK as a group-tourist guide at a travel agency specialized in group tourists
* It refers to a tourist guide at a travel agency specialized in only assisting group tourists assembled by a designated travel agency only in contrast to a tourist guide of a group tourist agency in general.
5) A person who has visited the ROK or OECD member countries more than two times and has no criminal or illegal immigration records. (*Entry based on visa exemption or as a group tourist to Jeju is NOT counted as the number of visit to ROK)
6) A person who has visited the ROK with a Medical Tourist visa
7) A person who has proved his/her assets including real estate, financial assets, or business ownership worth more than 5,000,000 yuan
8) A public/civil servant of China
9) An executive or an employee of a corporate which has invested more than $1,000,000 (or approximately 1,000,000,000 KRW) in the Republic of Korea
10) An executive or an employee of an airline or a shipping company providing services to the ROK
11) A VIP customer of an internationally-accepted credit card company with the granted level above Gold-Card
12) A person whose monthly income is more than 5,000 yuan (or an annual income of 60,000 yuan)
13) A retiree aged 55 or older who has collected his/her pension
14) An elementary, middle, or high school student, or a student, or a graduate from the listed universities on the 211 project
* Please check the website at http://www.moe.edu.cn/edoas/website18/51/info1207097171157851.htm
15) An employee or manager (or higher) who has been working for more than 6 months at a listed company from the 500 major corporations selected by Chinese Company Association
* Please check the website http://www.cec-ceda.org.cn
16) A person who has purchased a membership card (worth more than 30,000,000 KRW) of a condominium located in Korea*
* verified through a certificate of tax payment of acquisition
17) Parents, Parents-In-Law, Unmarried Child*, Spouse of a valid multiple-entry C-3 visa holder
* A person with multiple nationalities must follow the Guidelines of People with Multiple Nationalities except for a multiple-entry C-3-8 visa holder
18) Registered residents of Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen, who possess the new household registration record containing a tamperproof embedded chip * Those who do not have the new household registration record can present their passport, resident identity card, and old household registration record.
19) an executive of a private enterprise whose annual trade with ROK is worth US$30,000 or more, or a person who has worked for a respective company as a full-time employee for more than 2 years.

□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years,
if you have previously received a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years and have no criminal and illegal immigration records.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Two different documents proving your identity and financial ability to support yourself during the stay in ROK

[ Examples of Documents Proving Your Identity and Financial Ability ]
Proof of employment, credit card statement within the past 6 months, Certificate of Social Insurance Registration, Tax Clearance Certificate, Degree Certificate, Permanent Residence Certificate, Invitation Letter from a specific institution, a document proving that you have collected your pension, proof of employment verifying you have worked as an executive member or a full-time employee at a respective company, records of international trade with ROK

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
A multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year, 3 years, or 5 years will be issued to an eligible applicant.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 30 days.

question: For Chinese applicants, what amount of assets qualifies someone for the 3-year multiple-entry C-3-4 business visitor visa (embassy Case 2), and what amount qualifies them for the 5-year multiple-entry C-3-9 ordinary tourist visa (embassy Case 3)?
reference: For the 3-year C-3-4 visa, proven assets (real estate, financial assets, business ownership and so on) worth more than 5,000,000 yuan. For the 5-year C-3-9 visa, proven assets worth more than 2 million yuan.
answer: For the 3-year multiple-entry C-3-4 business visitor visa (embassy Case 2), a person must have proved assets including real estate, financial assets, or business ownership worth more than 5,000,000 yuan [2]. For the 5-year multiple-entry C-3-9 ordinary tourist visa (embassy Case 3), a person must have proved assets including real estate, financial assets, business ownership, etc. worth more than 2 million yuan [1].

citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to visit Korea on the purpose of travel for holidays or leisure

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are a person who plans to visit Korea on the purpose of travel for holidays or leisure

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Documents demonstrating the financial capacity during the stay in ROK or a document for identification

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months or a double-entry visa valid for 6 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days for a single-entry visa , and 30 days for a double-entry visa.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

a preferential visit card holder and the family (spouse, minor child, parents, and parents-in-law).

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of preferential visit card
③ Document proving applicant's qualification for a preferential visit card (bank book or certificate of bank account balance )
※ not applicable for holders of "preferential card without financial function"
④ A document proving family relations (Marriage Certificate, Certificate of Family Relation Records, Birth Certificate and others)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years. Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

### Embassy visa application — Case 3

#### Eligibility
□ Multiple Entry Visa (Valid for 5 years)

1) A faculty member* at a university (including junior college), or a teacher of elementary, middle, or high school
* A faculty member positioned higher than an assistant professor is eligible for multiple entry visa with validity of 10 years
2) Famous artists, entertainers, and athletes acknowledged by the head of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad

4) A person who has visited the ROK previously

question: A Chinese businessperson is invited by a company that the Ministry of Justice selected as a preferential company. How do they apply for the C-3-6 visa, what do they submit, and what visa validity and stay do they get?
reference: They apply through Confirmation of Visa Issuance, submitting the CCVI application form (Form No. 21), a copy of the passport and a photo, proof of employment, and an invitation letter issued by the selected corporation or association. If a representative applies, they also submit a power of attorney, their employment certificate and a copy of their ID card. The visa is multiple-entry, valid for 1 year, with stays of up to 90 days.
answer: The applicant is eligible to apply for a Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) because they are a person invited by preference companies or organizations selected by the Ministry of Justice [1]. They must submit an Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format, Proof of Employment, and an invitation letter issued by selected corporations or associations [1]. If a representative is hired, they must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, an employment certificate, and a copy of an ID Card [1]. The applicant can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year, and periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days [1].

question: Someone with a bachelor's degree who completed a research program at a Korean research institution within the last 3 years applies for a D-10-1 job seeker visa at an embassy. Which case-specific documents do they submit, and what must the completion certificate show?
reference: An education certificate, a completion certificate and a plan for seeking employment. The completion certificate is issued by the head of the research institution and states the research topic, research period and completion results.
answer: The applicant must submit an Education Certificate, a Completion Certificate, and a plan for seeking employment [1]. The Completion Certificate must indicate the research topic, research period, and completion results, and it must be issued by the head of the research institution [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: D-10-1 Job Seeker
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in a training or find a job in a field qualified for a visa of Professor(E-1), Foreign Language Instructor(E-2), Research(E-3), Technical Instructor/Technician(E-4), Professional(E-5), Artist/Athlete(E-6), and Foreign National of Special Ability(E-7)
- The activities not only include a job seeking or on-the-job training (including short-term paid internship) at an organization or company in ROK
* The activities related to Artist/Athlete(E-6) status only includes pure art or sports, and excludes adult entertainment businesses.

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

① A previous employee of a listed company on the Fortune's Global 500 companies for more than 1 year in recent 3 years
② A graduate of a university listed on the Times' Higher World University Rankings in recent 3 years
③ A graduate of a Korean community college or higher in recent 3 years
④ A person having a bachelor’s degree or above, completed a research program at a Korean research institution in recent 3 years.
⑤ Others who are specially acknowledged by the head of diplomatic mission

### Required documents
1. Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
2. Additional documents for each case
Case ① : Certificate of employment history (Proof of Employment), plan for seeking employment
Case ② : Proof of Education*, plan for seeking employment
* Degree (or a document confirming that you will receive a degree in the future), Certificate of Education, Certificate of your degree (Please choose one)
Case ③ : Proof of education and Transcript, plan for seeking employment
* If a proof of education in Korea can be verified via our system (International student Information System), you are exempt from submitting these documents.
Case ④ : Education Certificate, Completion Certificate*, plan for seeking employment
* A certificate indicating research topic, research period, completion results, which is issued by the head of research institution
Case ⑤ : Documents proving that you are a talent*, plan for seeking employment
* Proof of Education, career certificate, recommendation from the respective group or any other proving documents (if you have been awarded or covered by the media for winning a respected international or domestic competition)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: For a D-3-11 industrial trainee (FDI) Confirmation of Visa Issuance, the host company made its overseas investment in kind rather than in cash. Which documents prove that the host company is a foreign direct investment business?
reference: The Foreign Direct Investment Declaration (an original or a copy stamped by a public official) and a confirmation of an export permit issued by customs.
answer: To prove the host company is a permitted corporation recognized as Foreign Direct Investment Business when making investment in kind, a confirmation of an export permit issued by the customs is required [1]. Additionally, a Foreign Direct Investment Declaration (an original document or a copy stamped by a public official) must be submitted [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: D-3-11 Industrial Trainee (FDI)
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to receive a technical training at an industrial entity engaged in overseas direct investment in accordance with the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A production employee of a joint venture or an overseas subsidiary of Korean cooperation that is established in accordance with the employee's country law and has been running for at least 3 months, is deemed to be unable to acquire required skills in his/her country and is required to receive a job training.

[Trainee Requirements]
1. A healthy person aged between 18 and 40
2. More than 3 months of working experience at the Korean subsidiary
3. Acquiring second-level or higher, or score of 50 out of 200 on TOPIK (excluding those who have a bachelor’s degree or higher in Korea, or plan to receive training at the corporation that has signed the pledge to implement Korean language education of 5 hours or more a month as well as dispatches a full-time translator for every 100 trainees)

### Required documents
1. Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
2. Documents proving an invitee has met requirements for being an industrial trainee
① A copy of Business Registration Certificate of a branch office located in an applicant's country (or a charter)
② Invitee’s Employment Certificate issued by the head of a branch office and a copy of passport.
③ Documents proving sufficiency in Korean
※ if there is a Korean diplomatic mission in an applicant's country, ① and ② need to be authenticated by consular officers
3. A training course plan confirming the details of training schedule. (refer to Archive)
4. A letter of guarantee from inviter
5. Documents proving the host company is a permitted corporation recognized as Foreign Direct Investment Business
- Foreign Direct Investment Declaration (an original document or a copy stamped by a public official)
- when making investment in cash, a receipt or confirmation of wire transfer (an original document or a copy stamped by a bank)
- when making investment in kind, a confirmation of an export permit issued by the customs

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

question: For a D-3-13 industrial trainee (plant) application, what document shows how many full-time employees the host company has, and what is it used for?
reference: A statement of insurance qualification printed from the Ministry of Employment and Labor's Employment Insurance website. It is used to determine how many trainees the host company is permitted to accept.
answer: You need to submit a statement of insurance qualification printed out from the website of the Ministry of Employment and Labor (Employment Insurance website) [1]. This document is used to determine the permitted number of accepting trainees [1].

1. A healthy person aged between 18 and 40 2. More than 3 months of working experience at the Korean subsidiary

question: my mom is paying for my foreign language course in korea (D-4-7 visa). can i use her bank statement from 2 months ago?
reference: No. For the D-4-7 Confirmation of Visa Issuance, the account balance document must have been issued within the past 30 days. If you submit a parent's bank statement, you must also submit a family relation certificate.
answer: Documents proving an applicant's financial abilities must be reviewed through original copies, and the account balance must be issued within the past 30 days [1]. When submitting a parent's bank statement, a family relation certificate is required to be submitted [1].

⑤ Documents proving an applicant's financial statement*
* In principle, documents proving an applicant's financial abilities must be reviewed through original copies (ex, balance statement, bankbook, scholarship receipt, bank statement),and when necessary, a copy can be attached after an official-in-charge compares the original and the copy to confirm authenticity (account balance must be issued within the past 30 days).
- When submitting a parent's bank statement, family relation certificate is required to submit..

⑦ A certificate of an international student insurance policy or National Health Insurance (only for an elementary, middle/junior high, high school student)
* A graduate-to-be is excluded.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who meets the qualifications determined by the Minister of Justice, and plans to teach conversational language at a foreign language institute, affiliated- language research institute or educational institute of higher than elementary school, or language training institute affiliated with an enterprise or broadcasting company, or other equivalent organization.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. An instructor at an English Academy
- A person who teaches a foreign language in accordance with Article 3(3) of the presidential decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Private Teaching Institutes and Extracurricular Lessons
2. An instructor who is recruited/selected by an academic institution such as elementary school (or higher) or an affiliated language center
3. A foreign language instructor at corporate language centers for employee on-the-job-training
4. A foreign language instructor at a continuing education institute in accordance with the Lifelong Education Act
* School affiliated continuing education facilities, school·company's internal college·cyber university, business places· civil society groups· media affiliated continuing education facilities, continuing education related to knowledge·human resource development
5. A foreign language instructor teaching at a continuing education facility that is established and run by the state or other local governments in accordance with other laws (including regulations)
6. A foreign language instructor teaching at a vocational skills development facility or vocational training corporation established in accordance with the Workers Vocational Skills Development Act
7. A foreign language instructor teaching at a corporation or a public institute* which has set up a language center that has all the necessary equipment and facilities to study a foreign language for its employees

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A proof of an applicant's education authenticated by a public authority*.
Please, choose one from below to submit;
A copy of a degree, a copy of diploma, a graduation certificate indicating an acquisition of a degree
*The document needs to be authenticated by the Hague Apostille Convention(for a signatory of the convention), by consular officers of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad (for not a signatory of the convention), or by an official public institute in Korea (i.e. Korean Council for University Education), or by a government agency of applicants(Japanese only)
- If you have a degree from a university in ROK, an un-authenticated copy of a degree will also be accepted.
- If you have a history of submitting a document authenticated by the institutes listed above, you are exempt from the requirement.
③ A criminal record issued and authenticated by a public authority* in an applicant's country
* The document needs to be authenticated under the Hague Apostille Convention(for a signatory of the convention), by consular officers of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad (for not a signatory of the convention), or by consular officers of a foreign embassy in Korea (for a foreign resident in Korea)
- The criminal records that includes all criminal records across the country, must be issued within 6 months from the application date.
- If you have a history of submitting a criminal record authenticated by a public authority, staying and leaving ROK, and re-apply within 3 months from the last departure from ROK, you are exempt from submitting the document. However, if it has been more than 3 months since the last departure, you need to re-submit it when applying for an alien registration.
④ A Self-Assessment Report on Heath
⑤ An employment contract, and a document of the establishment of an academic institute or an organization
⑥ Other necessary documents for evaluation
- an outline of teachers management, a document suggesting the total number of students and faculties

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 2 years.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 2 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

question: Which foreign doctors are eligible for an E-5 professional visa through Confirmation of Visa Issuance, and at which kinds of institutions may they work?
reference: A doctor holding a foreign licence acknowledged by Korean law, recommended by the Minister of Health and Welfare, with advanced knowledge of the latest medical technology, who will work at a medical institution run by the government or a local government, a medical corporation, or a medical institution run by a non-profit corporation or a government-invested corporation. A graduate of a Korean medical or dental school who will do an internship or residency at a university-affiliated hospital or a hospital designated by the Minister of Health and Welfare is also eligible.
answer: A doctor recommended by the Minister of Health and Welfare of ROK who has advanced knowledge in the latest medical technology and plans to work at the following organizations is eligible: - A medical institution run by Government or Local government [1] - A medical corporation [1] - A medical institution run by a non-profit corporation or a government invested corporation [1]

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Spouse or a minor child of Overseas Korean (F-4) visa holders

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A spouse and minor child of overseas Koreans (F-4) visa holders

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A certificate of registration of a local abode or a copy of visa issuance (including a copy of passport) from Overseas Koreans (F-4) visa holders
③ Documents demonstrating family relations

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 90 days.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who was previously Korean and has acquired nationality of a country other than the countries notified by the Minister of Justice of ROK

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you

A person who was Korean and has acquired foreign nationality

### Required documents
1. Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
2. Records proving that you once had Korean nationality
- Certification of Family Registry, Certificate of Removal from Family Registry or closed Register and other documents proving that you were a citizens of the Republic of Korea
* For more information related these certifications, reference to Article 11 and 15 in 「Registration of Family Relations Act」in effected Jan 1st, 2008
3. Documents demonstrating the reason for and an exact date of obtaining foreign citizenship

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 2 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: For an F-2-3 spouse of a permanent resident visa at an embassy (Case 1), whose criminal records and health check-up results are required, and who must issue the health check-up?
reference: Criminal records of both spouses, issued by the responsible authority of each country, and health check-up results for the married couple. The health check-up must be issued by a medical institution equivalent to a hospital under the Medical Service Act or the Local Health Act; a foreign spouse may instead submit similar documents issued in their own country.
answer: Criminal records of both parties that are married are required, which must be issued by a responsible organization of respective country [1]. Health check-up results of a married couple are required, and the document must be issued by a medical institution equivalent to a hospital as set forth in the 「Medical Service Act 」or the Local Health Act [1]. However, if you are a foreign spouse, you can submit similar documents issued from your country instead [1].

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Spouse and a minor child of a permanent resident(F-5)

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A spouse of a Permanent Resident (F-5) visa holder

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An Invitation Letter(see Archives), Marriage Statement (see Archives)
③ Any relevant documents from both countries, which demonstrate the marital relationship
- Marriage certificate, certification of family relations records
④ Documents proving your funds and finance
⑤ Inviter's Proof of Residence
⑥ A letter of guarantee vouched by sponsor
⑦ Credit Reports of a sponsor
- It shall be issued by the Korean Foundation of Banks
⑧ Criminal Records of both parties that are married, which are issued by a responsible organization of respective country
⑨ Health check-up results of a married couple
- The document must be issued by a medical institution equivalent to a hospital as set forth in the 「Medical Service Act 」or the Local Health Act.
However, if you are a foreign spouse, you can submit similar documents issued from your country instead.
⑩ Any documents proving a dissolution of marriage if the applicant was married before (i.e. Divorce Certificate)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

③ Documents proving that the applicant is a minor child of a sponsor(Permanent Resident)

passages.snippet:
<붙임2>
(제1쪽 / Page1)
결혼 배경 진술서 (Personal Details Form for F-2-3 Visa)
<유의사항>
이 질문지는 영주자격 소지자의 배우자(F-2-3) 사증발급 또는 체류자격 변경허가를 신청하는 신청인이 작성합니다. 원칙적으로 이 서류에 기재된 정보에 따라 심사가 진행되니 신청인께서는 가능한 모든 질문에 답변하고, 영사 및 출입국관리공무원이 심사 시 참고할 수 있도록 답변과 관련된 입증서류가 있는 경우 모두 제출하시기 바랍니다. 답변이 누락되거나 입증서류가 제출되지 않는 경 우 심사가 지연되거나 불허될 수 있습니다.
만약 허가에 필요한 요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건입증에 필요한 서류를 갖추지 못하였음에도 요건을 충족한 것으로 보이기 위해 허위의 사실을 기재하거나 위조된 서류를 제출하는 것은 관련 법령에 의거 처벌될 뿐만 아니라, 한국 입국이 금지될 수 있습니다.
요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건을 입증하는 서류를 갖추지 못하였다면, 그 사유를 기재한 사유서를 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.
귀하가 제공하신 정보는 개인정보 보호법에 따라 보호되며, 다른 법령에 근거가 없는 한 출입국관리법에 따른 업무에만 활용됩니다.
<NOTE>
This form is to be completed by a person applying for a marriage visa(F-2-3). In principle, the evaluation of the visa application will be based on the information provided on this personal details form. Therefore, the questions must be answered to the best of the applicant's knowledge and submit any relevant documentation that can be provided to the consul or the immigration officer as reference. If a necessary answer has been omitted or any relevant documentation has not been submitted, the evaluation process for the application may be delayed or disapproved.
If conditions are not met for the visa or if falsified information and/or documentation are forged to meet the conditions required to receive the visa, you will be not only penalized under the relevant Act but also banned from entering the Republic of Korea. If you are unable to provide proper documentation, submit a statement stating the reason.
The information you provide in this form will be protected according to the Personal Information Protection Law, and will only be used for matters governed by the Immigration Act. 1. 인적사항 / PERSONAL INFORMATION
1.1 여권에 기재된 성명 / Your full name (as shown in your passport)
성 / Famliy name 명 / Given name
1.2 성별 / Sex [ ] 남 / Male [ ] 여 / Female
1.3 현지 언어로 성명을 기재하시오 / Your full name written in your native language 성 / Famliy name 명 / Given name
1.4 과거에 다른 이름을 사용하였던 적이 있습니까?(있다면 그 이름과 변경한 이유를 기재하시오 / Do you have other names you have been known by?(If yes, write the names and explain why you changed the names)
[ ] 예 / Yes [ ] 아니오 / No

question: If I apply for an F-6-1 spouse of a Korean national visa at a Korean embassy, what kind of visa is issued and what period of stay is granted?
reference: A multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years, with a period of stay of up to 90 days.
answer: You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years [1]. Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: F-6-1 Spouse of a Korean National
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person with valid marital status in ROK who plans to stay in Korea to continue his/her marriage

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person with valid marital status in Korea, who plans to stay in Korea to continue your marriage

### Required documents
A. Basic Required Documents
1. Visa Application Form, passport, 2 photo in a standard format, fee
2. A letter of guarantee from inviter
3. Marriage Migrant Invitation Letter
4. Marriage Migrant Personal Statement written in either Korean or English
5. Inviter's Basic Certificate
6. Inviter's Family Relation Certificate
7. Inviter's Copy of Resident Registration
8. Inviter's Marriage Certificate
9. Marriage Certificate from the Migrant's Country of Origin
( If the certificate cannot be issued in accordance with national legislations of the migrant's country, this requirement can be dropped )

B. Required Documents for Income and Residency of Inviter
1. Amount of Income Certificate (issued by the National Tax Services)
2. Credit Information Report

If you want to prove your Earned Income
3. Invoice of Withholding Tax (issued by the place of employment)
4. Certificate of Employment (If you are currently employed)
5. Certificate of Career (If you were employed in the past)
6. A copy of Business Registration Certificate (If you run the company)
※ If it is too difficult to prove your income through the documents mentioned above, you can submit following documents instead- copy of account bank statement, pay check, confirmation of health insurance qualification gain/loss, and etc.

If you want to prove your Business Income
7. Business Registration Certificate (not including agriculture, fishing industry)
8. any documents that can prove the applicant's annual income (ex, farmland register, certificate of member of association, confirmation letter on farming, agriculture·fishery confirmation, etc)
9. Documents proving other income or assets
10. Documents proving residency requirements(certified copy of real estate register or rental agreement)

C. Required Documents for Communication and Language Proficiency

Use of Korean Language (Select one for submission)
1. TOPIK Report Card
2. Designated Educational Organization Certificate
3. Certificate of Degree in Korean Language
4. Documents proving your are an overseas Korean with a foreign nationality
5. Documents proving you had lived in Korea before for one year or more

Use of Languages Other than Korean(Select one for submission)
6. documents proving your ability to speak the respective language
7. Documents proving you had lived abroad before for one year or more

D. Required Documents for Eligible Applicants for the International Marriage Introduction Program (Health Status, Criminal History)
1. International Marriage Introduction Program Certificate(The certificate is not required if its reference number is written on an invitation letter)
2. Criminal Record Check(Required for both bride and groom)
3. Health Examination Report(Required for both bride and groom)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: For a G-1-10 treatment and recuperation e-visa, when does the applicant not have to submit proof of ability to pay for treatment and living costs, and when can the business registration certificate and medical travel facilitator registration certificate be left out?
reference: Proof of financial ability is not required if the inviting organisation guarantees the applicant's personal identity. The business registration certificate and the certificate of medical travel facilitator registration are not required if the institute is registered at the Visa Portal.
answer: You are not required to submit documents proving a financial ability to afford the treatment and living expenses if an inviting organization guarantees a personal identity of an applicant [1]. The copy of Business Registration Certificate and a copy of Certificate of Medical Travel Facilitator Registration are not required to be submitted if an institute is registered at Visa Portal [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: G-1-10 Treatment and Recuperation
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A patient who plans to enter Korea for medical treatment or recuperation at a medical institution in ROK, or a caregiver (including family).

## E-visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. A foreign patient who desires to stay in the ROK for medical treatment or recuperation for 91 days or more, being invited by an excellent recruiting organization designated by the Minister of Justice as an e-visa application agency

2. A family member or a caregiver who requires accompanying the patient to nurse him/her*

② Documents proving the purpose of treatment issued by a medical institute

※ If an inviting organization guarantees a personal identity of an applicant, you are not required to submit this document.
④ A copy of Business Registration Certificate and a copy of Certificate of Medical Travel Facilitator Registration
※ If an institute is registered at Visa Portal, you are not required to submit this document.
⑤ Documents proving an accompanying family member and a caregiver

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.

Overseas Korean aged 25 or older with foreign nationality defined in the 「Act on Immigration and Legal Status of Overseas Koreans」 who is applied to any of the followings:
1. A person who was Korean at the time of birth and has a Certificate of Family Registry, Certificate of Removal from Family Registry or closed Register

3. question: Who qualifies for the F-5-11 special talent visa in the business management field?
reference: (1) A full-time director of a company with capital of more than 8 billion KRW and more than 300 full-time employees, who is recommended by the head of the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry, the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency or the Korean Federation of Industries; and (2) a multinational manager or executive who has worked for 1 year or more at a company listed among the 500 companies in the past 3 years selected by UNCTAD, FORTUNE, FORBES, BUSINESS WEEK (US) or ECONOMIST (UK), and who is working as an executive at a Korean branch.
answer: A full-time director at a company with capitals worth more than 8 billion KRW and more than 300 full-time employees who is recommended by the head of the Korea Chamber of Commerce · Industry, Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency, or the Korean Federation of Industries qualifies [1]. Additionally, a multinational manager or an executive who has worked for 1 year or more at a company listed on the 500 companies in the past 3 years selected by UNCTAD, FORTUNE, FORBES, BUSINESS WEEK(US), or ECONOMIST(UK) and is working at a Korean branch as an executive qualifies [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: F-5-11 Special talent
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who has recognized by the Minister of Justice for his/her excellence in a specific field including science, management, education, cultural arts, and athletics

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you have talents in specialized areas such as :

[Science]
- A person recommended by the Minister of Science, ICT, and Future Planning on the basis of the awards history, research publication or citation on SCI (Science Technology Research Citation Index), or Research Results

[Business Management]
- A full-time director at a company with capitals worth more than 8 billion KRW and more than 300 full-time employees, and who is recommended by the head of the Korea Chamber of Commerce · Industry, Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency, or the Korean Federation of Industries.
- A multinational manager or an executive who has worked for 1 year or more at a company listed on the 500 companies in the past 3 years selected by UNCTAD, FORTUNE, FORBES, BUSINESS WEEK(US), or ECONOMIST(UK) and is working at a Korean branch as an executive

[Education]
- A person who is recommended by the Minister of Education on the basis of research publications and citations on SSCI (Social Science Research Citation Index) or A · HCI (Arts and Humanity Research Citation Index), and research achievements.
- A person who is recommended by the Minister of Education, Science and Technology as the status of a full-time lecturer or higher at a community college or above

[Culture＆Arts]
- An internationally famous artist, director, or singer recommended by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism

[Sports]
- An athlete and a coach who won a bronze medal or above at an international athletic competition equivalent to the Olympic, the World Championship, the Asian Game and others. Soccer players and the coaches finished in the Top 16 at the World Cup Game while being recommended by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism of ROK

### Required documents
1. Common documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Personal Statements
③ Documents proving your annual incomes
④ Documents proving that you have published your research paper in a prominent journal, such as SCI (Science Citation Index), or documents proving your research achievement(s).
⑤ A letter of guarantee
⑥ Degree and other materials(Awards History in relevant field, Certificates of your career experiences)

2. Additional documents for each case
① Science Field: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Science, ICT and Future Planning for Science / a recommendation letter from the Minister of Education for Education
② Education Field: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Education
③ If you are in Business Management, you need to submit a recommendation letter from the head of the Korea Chamber of Commerce＆Industry, the Korea Trade Investment Promotion Agency, or the Federation of Korean Industry
※ If you worked as a multinational manager or an executive at a company listed on the Top 500 companies of the world, you need to submit A proof of employment or a certificate of your career experience that can prove your work experiences.
④ Culture and Sports Area: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism for those in culture and sports industry

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

question: Under the Regulation on Management of Group e-Visa Application Agency, what may the head of Seoul Immigration Office or of an overseas diplomatic mission investigate about an agency's actual condition?
reference: Its attraction of group tourists; the actual handling of its work, including group-visa applications; its management of personal information; and its compliance with the other provisions of the regulation. They may also ask the agency to submit related documents for the investigation.
answer: The head of Seoul Immigration Office or the head of an overseas diplomatic mission may investigate the following regarding an agency's actual condition: 1. Attraction of group tourists [1]. 2. Actual condition of work handling, including group-visa application matters [1]. 3. Management of personal information [1]. 4. Compliance with other provisions under this regulation [1].

question: A group e-visa application agency had an average of 400 tourists over the last 3 months, received no sanctions in the last 3 months, and has a rate of illegal stay of 2.5%. Which administrative sanction applies under Table 1 of the regulation?
reference: Because the 3-month average is 300 or more, the rate of illegal stay is used instead of the number of illegal stayers. A rate of 2.0 to less than 3.0% corresponds to a 6-month suspension of agency operation.
answer: The administrative sanction that applies is a Suspension (6 months) [1]. This is because the agency's rate of illegal stay is 2.5%, which falls within the 2.0% to less than 3.0% range, and the number of illegal stayers is between 9 and 10 [1]. Since the agency received no warnings or suspensions in the last 3 months, the sanction is not increased to a higher level [1, 2].

question: May a group e-visa application agency apply for a group visa at an overseas Korean diplomatic mission instead of through the Visa Portal?
reference: In principle no; it must apply through the Visa Portal. The exceptions are where the Minister of Justice has approved it on the condition of a specified period of time, or where group e-visas cannot be issued because of unavoidable circumstances such as computer network problems.
answer: No, a Group e-Visa Application Agency shall not apply for a group visa with an overseas diplomatic mission and shall apply for group e-visas through the Visa Portal [1]. However, this rule does not apply where the Minister of Justice has approved on the condition of a specified period of time, or where group e-visas cannot be issued on unavoidable circumstances such as computer network problems, etc. [1].

Article 4 (General responsibility of Group e-Visa Application Agency)
① A Group e-Visa Application Agency shall make genuine efforts to process group e-visa applications under the related laws and regulations and shall comply with the matters falling under each of the following subparagraphs.
1. A Group e-Visa Application Agency shall make genuine efforts to provide visa applicants adequate guidance on required documents and procedures for visa applications, etc. and shall not unduly require excessive fees for visa application agency services.
2. A Group e-Visa Application Agency shall not lend its name to a non-designated travel agency.
3. A Group e-Visa Application Agency shall not submit any false documents or state any false information in relation to visa applications and shall, in good faith, check the authenticity of the documents that visa applicants have submitted.
4. Personal details of the group members, travel plans, etc. shall be accurately entered into the Visa Portal when applying for group e-visas.
5. A Group e-Visa Application Agency shall apply for group e-visa through the Visa Portal, and shall not apply for a group visa with an overseas diplomatic mission: Provided, That the foregoing shall not apply where the Minister of Justice has approved on the condition of a specified period of time, or where group e-visas cannot be issued on unavoidable circumstances such as computer network problems, etc.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person or group who plans to visit Korea for travel, or for small-scale cross border trading, guaranteed by an applicant''s travel agency

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa, if you are group tourists whose visa is applied by a designated travel agency.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Reference letter of designated travel agency

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months. Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.
The visa holder is not permitted to extend or change his/her visa.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who plans to visit Korea for small-scale cross border trading, whose visa is applied by a designated travel agency.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Reference letter of designated travel agency

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months. Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.
The visa holder is not permitted to extend or change his/her visa.

### Embassy visa application — Case 3

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are an individual tourist whose visa is applied by a designated travel agency.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee

You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months. Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.
The visa holder is not permitted to extend or change his/her visa.

## E-visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

part of a tour group who gets your visa through a travel agency designated by the head of Korean diplomatic mission abroad and approved by the Minister of Justice.

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form, a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Reference letter of designated travel agency

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days.
The visa holder is not eligible to change the duration or apply for an extension during his/her stay in ROK.

reference: Sweden has designated all notaries public as competent authorities (about 250, appointed by the County Administrative Boards); the Ministry for Foreign Affairs has not issued apostilles since 1 January 2005. The average cost is SEK 250 (about 27 euros).

passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Spouse and a minor child of a permanent resident(F-5)

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A spouse of a Permanent Resident (F-5) visa holder

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An Invitation Letter(see Archives), Marriage Statement (see Archives)
③ Any relevant documents from both countries, which demonstrate the marital relationship
- Marriage certificate, certification of family relations records
④ Documents proving your funds and finance
⑤ Inviter's Proof of Residence
⑥ A letter of guarantee vouched by sponsor
⑦ Credit Reports of a sponsor
- It shall be issued by the Korean Foundation of Banks
⑧ Criminal Records of both parties that are married, which are issued by a responsible organization of respective country
⑨ Health check-up results of a married couple
- The document must be issued by a medical institution equivalent to a hospital as set forth in the 「Medical Service Act 」or the Local Health Act.
However, if you are a foreign spouse, you can submit similar documents issued from your country instead.
⑩ Any documents proving a dissolution of marriage if the applicant was married before (i.e. Divorce Certificate)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A minor child of a Permanent Resident(F-5) visa holder

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An invitation Letter
③ Documents proving that the applicant is a minor child of a sponsor(Permanent Resident)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

(제1쪽 / Page1)
결혼 배경 진술서 (Personal Details Form for F-2-3 Visa)
<유의사항>
이 질문지는 영주자격 소지자의 배우자(F-2-3) 사증발급 또는 체류자격 변경허가를 신청하는 신청인이 작성합니다. 원칙적으로 이 서류에 기재된 정보에 따라 심사가 진행되니 신청인께서는 가능한 모든 질문에 답변하고, 영사 및 출입국관리공무원이 심사 시 참고할 수 있도록 답변과 관련된 입증서류가 있는 경우 모두 제출하시기 바랍니다. 답변이 누락되거나 입증서류가 제출되지 않는 경 우 심사가 지연되거나 불허될 수 있습니다.
만약 허가에 필요한 요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건입증에 필요한 서류를 갖추지 못하였음에도 요건을 충족한 것으로 보이기 위해 허위의 사실을 기재하거나 위조된 서류를 제출하는 것은 관련 법령에 의거 처벌될 뿐만 아니라, 한국 입국이 금지될 수 있습니다.
요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건을 입증하는 서류를 갖추지 못하였다면, 그 사유를 기재한 사유서를 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.
귀하가 제공하신 정보는 개인정보 보호법에 따라 보호되며, 다른 법령에 근거가 없는 한 출입국관리법에 따른 업무에만 활용됩니다.
<NOTE>
This form is to be completed by a person applying for a marriage visa(F-2-3). In principle, the evaluation of the visa application will be based on the information provided on this personal details form. Therefore, the questions must be answered to the best of the applicant's knowledge and submit any relevant documentation that can be provided to the consul or the immigration officer as reference. If a necessary answer has been omitted or any relevant documentation has not been submitted, the evaluation process for the application may be delayed or disapproved.
If conditions are not met for the visa or if falsified information and/or documentation are forged to meet the conditions required to receive the visa, you will be not only penalized under the relevant Act but also banned from entering the Republic of Korea. If you are unable to provide proper documentation, submit a statement stating the reason.
The information you provide in this form will be protected according to the Personal Information Protection Law, and will only be used for matters governed by the Immigration Act. 1. 인적사항 / PERSONAL INFORMATION

question: What does the Korean visa application form ask about trips to countries other than Korea?
reference: Whether the applicant has travelled outside their country of residence, excluding to Korea, in the last 5 years, and if so the name of each country (in English), the purpose of the visit and the period of stay.
answer: The application form asks if the applicant has travelled outside his/her country of residence, excluding to Korea, in the last 5 years [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]. If the answer is "Yes," the applicant must provide details of these trips, including the name of the country (in English), the purpose of visit, and the period of stay (yyyy/mm/dd)~ (yyyy/mm/dd) [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].

question: On the Korean visa application form, what details must you give about the person or organisation who will pay your travel-related expenses?
reference: The name of the person or organisation (company), its relationship to the applicant, the type of support, and a contact number.
answer: You must provide the following details for the person or organization who will pay for the applicant's travel-related expenses: - Name of Person/Organization (Company) [1, 2, 4, 5] - Relationship to the applicant [1, 2, 4, 5] - Type of Support [1, 2, 4, 5] - Contact No. [1, 2, 4, 5] Additionally, the User Manual for Electronic Form specifies entering the name of the person/company that pays the expenses, the relationship with the payer, what is financially supported by the payer, and the contact information of the payer [3].

question: According to the Application for Certificate of Visa Eligibility form, under which provision is the certificate applied for, and who signs the application?
reference: Article 17(2) of the Enforcement Regulations of the Immigration Act. The applicant, who is the inviting person, signs it; the form also has a line for the signature of a parent or legal guardian for a person under 17.
answer: The application for the Certificate of Visa Eligibility is made in accordance with Article 17(2) of the Enforcement Regulations of the Immigration Act [1]. The applicant or the inviting person must sign the application [1, 2], and for a person under 17 years of age, the signature of a parent or legal guardian is required [1, 3, 5].

question: Compare the processing procedure printed on the Application for Certificate of Visa Eligibility with the one on the regular visa application form. Which offices handle the steps in each?
reference: Certificate of Visa Eligibility: the applicant or inviting person fills in the application, the Immigration Office handles reception, assessment and notification of the result, and the visa application and issuance then take place at a diplomatic mission. Regular visa application: after the applicant applies, the diplomatic mission handles every step (reception, review, approval and issuance).
answer: The provided passages do not contain the processing procedure for a regular visa application form, so a comparison cannot be made. The processing procedure for the Application for Certificate of Visa Eligibility involves the following steps and offices: 1. Application for Certificate: Applicant or Inviting person [1]. 2. Reception: Immigration Office (Office, Branch Office) [1]. 3. Assessment: Immigration Office (Office, Branch Office) [1]. 4. Notification: Immigration Office (Office, Branch Office) [1]. 5. Visa Application and Issuance: Immigration Office (Diplomatic Mission) [1].

Article 5 (Group e-Visa Application and processing procedures)
① A Group e-Visa Application Agency shall apply for a group e-Visa by accessing the Visa Portal.

- 7 - Readable Passport) Reader or by entering the information directly: Provided, That where entering the information directly, a passport photo and a copy of passport of a group leader as well as of group members shall be registered at the Visa Portal after having them scanned.

Article 3 (Designation of a Group e-Visa Application Agency)
① Where a group visa application agency applies for a designation as a group e-Visa application agency, the head of an overseas diplomatic mission shall request for the designation thereof to the head of Seoul Immigration Office
(Head of E-Visa Center) by entering the relevant information1) of the application agency into the Integrated Visa Information System (IVIS) with the related documents2) attached. In this case, access authorization to the Visa Portal (ID, Password) shall be requested as well.
② An application agency which has its designation revoked under this regulation shall be allowed to apply, as prescribed in paragraph (1), in two full years from the revocation.
③ The Head of Seoul Immigration Office shall notify whether the designation is approved to the head of an overseas diplomatic mission through the KVIS after conducting a review of the designation request under paragraph (1).
④ The head of an overseas diplomatic mission shall notify the relevant application agency whether the designation as a group e-Visa application agency is approved, and shall announce the fact by an appropriate means, including posting the fact on the Internet homepage of the mission, etc.
1) Relevant Information: Required (travel agency name, certificate number of China National Tourism Administration, business license number, personal information of representative, contact number and address), personal information and contact number of staff in charge, administrative sanctions (grounds, disposition, period, disposition authority, etc.), etc.
2) Relevant Document: For China, certificate of permission for travel agency operation ,business license (Equivalent documents for Southeast Asian region)

question: Under which provision does the Confirmation of e-Visa Issuance state that the e-visa application was approved?
reference: Article 7(2) of the Korean Immigration Act (the Korean text cites Article 7-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Immigration Act, on online visa applications).
answer: The e-visa application was approved in accordance with article 7(2) of the Korean Immigration Act [1, 2, 3].
