passages.title: Visa guide: E-5 Professional
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person with a national certificate such as a foreign lawyer, certified public accountant, doctor, etc. under the laws of the Republic of Korea who plans to engage in professional work in legal, accounting, medical and other fields prescribed by the laws of the Republic of Korea [However, a person who falls under the E-1 Professor status is excluded]

## E-visa application

### E-visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A foreign lawyer, an accountant, a doctor, or a person with other national certification recognized by the law of ROK, who plans to engage in professional activities such as law, accountancy, or medical treatment accordingly (excluding those who fall under a status of stay of professor (E-1))

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form, a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A degree certificate and a copy of license
③ A recommendation letter from the head of a responsible government department. If you wish to work in Korean Free Economic Zone, you must submit an employment recommendation letter or a document proving the necessity of employment issued by the respective mayor or provincial governor.
④ An employment contract

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: Which item in the visa details section appears on the Confirmation of e-Visa Issuance for a group but not on the individual Confirmation of e-Visa Issuance?
reference: The intended date of arrival. Both forms list the status of stay, period of stay, number of entries, date of issue and expiry date; only the group form adds the intended date of arrival.
answer: The item "Intended Date of Arrival" appears in the VISA DETAILS section of the Confirmation of E-Visa Issuance for Group [1, 2] but is not listed in the VISA DETAILS section of the individual Confirmation of E-Visa Issuance [3].

passages.title: Visa guide: E-2-1 Foreign Language Instructor (General)
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who meets the qualifications determined by the Minister of Justice, and plans to teach conversational language at a foreign language institute, affiliated- language research institute or educational institute of higher than elementary school, or language training institute affiliated with an enterprise or broadcasting company, or other equivalent organization.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. An instructor at an English Academy
- A person who teaches a foreign language in accordance with Article 3(3) of the presidential decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Private Teaching Institutes and Extracurricular Lessons
2. An instructor who is recruited/selected by an academic institution such as elementary school (or higher) or an affiliated language center
3. A foreign language instructor at corporate language centers for employee on-the-job-training
4. A foreign language instructor at a continuing education institute in accordance with the Lifelong Education Act
* School affiliated continuing education facilities, school·company's internal college·cyber university, business places· civil society groups· media affiliated continuing education facilities, continuing education related to knowledge·human resource development
5. A foreign language instructor teaching at a continuing education facility that is established and run by the state or other local governments in accordance with other laws (including regulations)
6. A foreign language instructor teaching at a vocational skills development facility or vocational training corporation established in accordance with the Workers Vocational Skills Development Act
7. A foreign language instructor teaching at a corporation or a public institute* which has set up a language center that has all the necessary equipment and facilities to study a foreign language for its employees

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A proof of an applicant's education authenticated by a public authority*.
Please, choose one from below to submit;
A copy of a degree, a copy of diploma, a graduation certificate indicating an acquisition of a degree
*The document needs to be authenticated by the Hague Apostille Convention(for a signatory of the convention), by consular officers of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad (for not a signatory of the convention), or by an official public institute in Korea (i.e. Korean Council for University Education), or by a government agency of applicants(Japanese only)
- If you have a degree from a university in ROK, an un-authenticated copy of a degree will also be accepted.
- If you have a history of submitting a document authenticated by the institutes listed above, you are exempt from the requirement.
③ A criminal record issued and authenticated by a public authority* in an applicant's country
* The document needs to be authenticated under the Hague Apostille Convention(for a signatory of the convention), by consular officers of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad (for not a signatory of the convention), or by consular officers of a foreign embassy in Korea (for a foreign resident in Korea)
- The criminal records that includes all criminal records across the country, must be issued within 6 months from the application date.
- If you have a history of submitting a criminal record authenticated by a public authority, staying and leaving ROK, and re-apply within 3 months from the last departure from ROK, you are exempt from submitting the document. However, if it has been more than 3 months since the last departure, you need to re-submit it when applying for an alien registration.
④ A Self-Assessment Report on Heath
⑤ An employment contract, and a document of the establishment of an academic institute or an organization
⑥ Other necessary documents for evaluation
- an outline of teachers management, a document suggesting the total number of students and faculties

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 2 years.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 2 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

passages.title: Visa guide: F-5-11 Special talent
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who has recognized by the Minister of Justice for his/her excellence in a specific field including science, management, education, cultural arts, and athletics

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you have talents in specialized areas such as :

[Science]
- A person recommended by the Minister of Science, ICT, and Future Planning on the basis of the awards history, research publication or citation on SCI (Science Technology Research Citation Index), or Research Results

[Business Management]
- A full-time director at a company with capitals worth more than 8 billion KRW and more than 300 full-time employees, and who is recommended by the head of the Korea Chamber of Commerce · Industry, Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency, or the Korean Federation of Industries.
- A multinational manager or an executive who has worked for 1 year or more at a company listed on the 500 companies in the past 3 years selected by UNCTAD, FORTUNE, FORBES, BUSINESS WEEK(US), or ECONOMIST(UK) and is working at a Korean branch as an executive

[Education]
- A person who is recommended by the Minister of Education on the basis of research publications and citations on SSCI (Social Science Research Citation Index) or A · HCI (Arts and Humanity Research Citation Index), and research achievements.
- A person who is recommended by the Minister of Education, Science and Technology as the status of a full-time lecturer or higher at a community college or above

[Culture＆Arts]
- An internationally famous artist, director, or singer recommended by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism

[Sports]
- An athlete and a coach who won a bronze medal or above at an international athletic competition equivalent to the Olympic, the World Championship, the Asian Game and others. Soccer players and the coaches finished in the Top 16 at the World Cup Game while being recommended by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism of ROK

### Required documents
1. Common documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Personal Statements
③ Documents proving your annual incomes
④ Documents proving that you have published your research paper in a prominent journal, such as SCI (Science Citation Index), or documents proving your research achievement(s).
⑤ A letter of guarantee
⑥ Degree and other materials(Awards History in relevant field, Certificates of your career experiences)

2. Additional documents for each case
① Science Field: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Science, ICT and Future Planning for Science / a recommendation letter from the Minister of Education for Education
② Education Field: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Education
③ If you are in Business Management, you need to submit a recommendation letter from the head of the Korea Chamber of Commerce＆Industry, the Korea Trade Investment Promotion Agency, or the Federation of Korean Industry
※ If you worked as a multinational manager or an executive at a company listed on the Top 500 companies of the world, you need to submit A proof of employment or a certificate of your career experience that can prove your work experiences.
④ Culture and Sports Area: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism for those in culture and sports industry

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

passages.title: Visa guide: F-1-23 Household assistant of high-tech investor
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to work for an advanced technology investor as a household assistant under contract with him/her

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A household assistant of a foreign investor who has invested $100,000 or more in high tech information business and acquired a status of stay of a Corporate/Foreign Investor (D-8), a Resident (F-2), or a Permanent Resident (F-5)
※ The person must have been employed for at least 1 year by the same employer in other countries.
※ A foreign investor must be a CEO or an executive of a high tech company with at least three Korean full-time workers.

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A Foreign Investment Notification form (A certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register or a copy of Business Registration Certificate ) or a copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
※ If you are a visa holder of Business Venture (D-8-2) and Technology and Business Startup (D-8-4), Business venture confirmation or a prospective venture confirmation
※ If you are a visa holder of Business Startup (D-8-4), you must submit documents proving industrial property rights and other certificates to prove the rights to technology and other copyrights
③ An employer's proof of employment (i.e. certificate of identification)
④ A document proving the income status of the employer
- A receipt for earned income tax withholding, certificate of income amount, payslip, a copy of an applicant's bankbook
※ The employer's income should be three times more than gross national income (GNI) of the previous year announced by the Bank of Korea
⑤ A document proving a company is hiring Korean full-time workers (for those whose investment is worth less than US $500,000)
※ e.g. receipt for earned income tax withholding, certificate indicating the amount of income, payslip, a copy of bankbook
⑥ An employment contract of household assistant
⑦ A letter of guarantee
⑧ A document proving a level of education of the household employee
⑨ A document proving that the household assistant has been hired by the employer for at least one year
※ e.g. Employment contract, payslip, a copy of bankbook

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A household assistant of a foreign investor who has invested more than $100,000 and less than $500,000 in an advanced IT business, and acquired status of stay of a Corporate/Foreign Investor (D-8), a Resident (F-2), or a Permanent Resident (F-5)
※ A foreign investor must be a CEO or a board member of an advanced IT firm which has 3 or more full-time Korean workers.
※ A household assistant who is hired abroad for at least 1 year can apply a visa to a Korean diplomatic mission abroad.

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A Foreign Investment Notification form (A certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register or a copy of Business Registration Certificate ) or A copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
※ If you are a visa holder of Business Venture(D-8-2) and Technology and Business Startup(D-8-4), Business venture confirmation or prospective venture confirmation
※ If you are a visa holder of Technology and Business Startup(D-8-4), you must submit documents proving you have obtained industrial property rights or other documents proving possession of technologies and right to use the technologies, etc.
③ A proof of employment of employer (A copy of ID)
④ A document proving the income status of the employer
- a receipt for earned Income tax withholding, certificate of Income amount, payslip, a copy of an applicant's bankbook
※ The income should be three times more than gross national income (GNI) of the previous year based on the Bank of Korea
⑤ A document proving the current employment status of a household assistant (If an applicant's investment worth less than US $500,000)
※ a receipt for earned income tax withholding, certificate of income amount, payslip, a copy
of bankbook and others
⑥ A labor contract for household assistant
⑦ A letter of guarantee
⑧ A document proving the level of education of a household assistant

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

citations.title: Visa guide: C-1 Short-Term News Coverage
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

1. A person dispatched from a foreign newspaper, broadcasting channel, journal, and other media to cover/report news
2. A person to cover and report news under contract with foreign media
3. A person to stay for a short period of time to establish a branch in ROK

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. A representative of the foreign media travelling to the Republic of Korea for temporary news coverage · report
2. A journalist seeking for temporary news coverage · report on the basis of a contract with the foreign media
3. A representative preparing to establish a Korean branch office of the foreign media outlet

※ If you continue to stay in the ROK after you have successfully established the Korean branch office, you are allowed to change your status of stay to the Long- Term News Coverage ( D-5 ) visa.

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An international press card or a document demonstrating an applicant's current employment status or overseas assignment

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years. Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

question: Under the (temporarily suspended) visa-free entry programme for tourists in transit to third countries, what conditions must a traveller meet regarding their onward ticket, past record in Korea, and stopover?
reference: They need a confirmed onward flight ticket departing within 30 days of entering Korea and no criminal record such as overstay in the countries concerned. In the 3 years before entry they must not have been denied entry to Korea, fined more than 5 million KRW, or forcibly evicted or given a deportation order. They must not have stayed more than 3 days in the transit or stopover country, unless they are returning to the immediately previous point of departure.
answer: You must have a confirmed onward flight ticket for departure within 30 days after entering Korea, and have no record of criminal offence such as overstay in the countries mentioned above [1, 2, 3]. You must not have been denied entry into Korea, and you must not have been fined more than 5 million KRW, forcibly evicted, or received a deportation order for violation of law in the past 3 years preceding the date of entry [1, 2, 3]. You must have stayed no more than 3 days in the country of transit or stopover, though this is not applicable when the person is returning to the immediate previous point of departure (country of transit or stopover) [1, 2, 3].

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Person who plans to visit Korea for tour or transit without a visa

#### Visa Free Entry Guide
Visa is a fundamental requirement to enter the Republic of Korea, and in principle, foreigners must have valid visas when they travel. However, those who fall under any of the following categories below are allowed to enter Korea without visas. (Article 7(2) of the Immigration Act)
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
Even if the foreigner has the valid visa or is subject to visa-free entry, he/she may be denied entry to the Republic of Korea if he's found inadmissible by an immigration officer at the port of entry.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)
### Tourists in transit to Third Countries (* Temporarily Suspended due to COVID-19)

#### 1. Eligible Applicants
-
Nationals of countries, except for the 24 xecluded countries (Syria, Sudan, Iran, Macedonia, Cuba, Republic Of Kosovo, Palestine, Afghanistan, Iraq, Nigeria, Ghana, Yemen, Gambia, Senegal, Bangladesh, Kyrgyzstan, Pakistan, Somalia, Uzbekistan, Nepal, Cameron, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Egypt) that are not granted visa free entry into Korea.
-
(a) Persons who hold a visa to the United States(including Guam and Saipan), Canada, Australia, or New Zealand, who transit through Korea to enter the abovementioned countries; or (b) persons who stayed in and departed from one of the abovementioned countries and transit through Korea bound for the country of origin or a third country.
-
(a) Persons who hold a visa (or permanent residency) to at least one of the 30 European countires (Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Latvia, Rumania, Luxemburg, Lithuania, Liechtenstein, Malta, Belgium, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Slovenia, Iceland, Ireland, Estonia, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech, Cyprus, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, Hungary), who transit through Korea bound for one of the 30 European countries; or (b) persons who departed from one of the 30 European countries, transit through Korea bound for the country of origin or a third country.

#### 2. Requirements
-
Persons who hold a visa (re-entry permit, permanent residency, etc.) to enter the United States, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand (hereinafter referred to as “the four advanced countries”) and
-
1) who go to one of the four advanced countries in transit through Korea; or
-
2) who stay in one of the four advanced countries and take a direct flight from the country to Korea to go to a country of nationality or a third country.
-
Please be noted that:
-
- If you are a U.S. visa holder who transit through Korea and Saipan to reach the U.S. as the final destination, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. (However, if you depart from the U.S. and enter Korea via Saipan, you are not granted no-visa entry to Korea.)
-
- If you are a Chinese group tourist holding a group-tourist visa to Japan and meet certain requirements (e.g. using a travel agency that only attracts Chinese group tourists), you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa.
-
- If you hold an e-visa to Australia and a visa label is attached to your passport, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. However, if the label is not on your passport, you are granted no-visa entry only when you depart from Australia and transit through Korea.

#### 3. Condition of Permission
-
You have a confirmed onward flight ticket for departure within 30 days after entering Korea, in addition to having no record of criminal offence such as overstay in the countries mentioned above
-
You had not been denied entry into Korea, or had not been fined more than 5 million KRW or not have been forcibly evicted or received a deportation order for violation of law in the past 3 years preceding the date of entry
-
You stayed no more than 3 days in the country of transit or stopover. (But, Not applicable when the person is returning to the immediate previous point of departure(country of transit or stopover)
-
For hloders of U.S., Canada, Australia, or New Zealand e-visas, a visa sticker must be attached to the passport; if unattached, visa free entry will be applicable when departing from the 4 countries mentioned above bound for the country of origin or a third country.

question: A representative of a foreign media outlet enters Korea on a C-1 visa to set up the outlet's Korean branch. If they stay on after the branch is established, which status can they change to, and for how long is a period of stay granted on that visa?
reference: They can change to the Long-Term News Coverage (D-5) visa. The D-5 period of stay is granted for up to 1 year (both at an embassy and through Confirmation of Visa Issuance).
answer: You are allowed to change your status of stay to the Long-Term News Coverage (D-5) visa [1]. The passages do not state the period of stay granted for the D-5 visa [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: C-1 Short-Term News Coverage
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

1. A person dispatched from a foreign newspaper, broadcasting channel, journal, and other media to cover/report news
2. A person to cover and report news under contract with foreign media
3. A person to stay for a short period of time to establish a branch in ROK

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. A representative of the foreign media travelling to the Republic of Korea for temporary news coverage · report
2. A journalist seeking for temporary news coverage · report on the basis of a contract with the foreign media
3. A representative preparing to establish a Korean branch office of the foreign media outlet

※ If you continue to stay in the ROK after you have successfully established the Korean branch office, you are allowed to change your status of stay to the Long- Term News Coverage ( D-5 ) visa.

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An international press card or a document demonstrating an applicant's current employment status or overseas assignment

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay

question: im finishing my bachelors next semester and i have a patent for my startup idea. can i apply for the D-10-2 startup visa before i graduate?
reference: Yes. The D-10-2 is open to a person with a bachelor's degree or above, including a prospective graduate, who is preparing to set up a business with an intellectual property right or equivalent skills.
answer: You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are a person having a bachelor's degree or above (including a prospective graduate) preparing for business establishment with intellectual property right or equivalent skills [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: D-4-6 General Trainee (Private Institute)
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to receive training at a private academic institute with an outstanding performance

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible for this visa if you are

A person who plans to receive training at an institute established by a company listed on the Korea Stock Exchange or associated with technology vocational institute. Also a person who plans to receive training at an vocational technology institute affiliated with an university, or a branch of a widely-known international technology vocational institute located in ROK, or an academic institute under contract of exclusive operation with a widely-known international technology vocational institute

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register( Business Registration Certificate or registration number certificate) of a respective academic institution
③ An acceptance letter issued by an academic institution
④ Documents proving an applicant's financial statement*
* In principle, documents proving an applicant's financial abilities must be reviewed with the original documents (i.e. an account balance, bankbook, scholarship receipt from a training institute, bank statement), and when necessary, a copy must be attached after the original document is compared with the copy to confirm authenticity (account balance must be issued within the past 30 days)
⑤ A Certificate of Enrollment or any other documents proving the highest level of education
⑥ A training course plan (lecture schedule, instructors' profile, training facility information, tuition fees)
⑦ A receipt of full payment of tuition or admission
⑧ In the case of training by an institute associated with or established by a Korean listed company, documents proving that the institute is under contract or is established by the company must be submitted
※ In the case of having difficulties in proving reliability of documents with official documents, any equivalent will be accepted
⑨ In case of training at a university-affiliated institute, documents proving that the institute is affiliated with the university must be submitted
⑩ In case of training at a Korean branch of an international education institute, documents proving that the branch belongs to the institute, or the institute is a contract holder of an exclusive operation agreement with ROK

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

An executive, senior manager, or specialist dispatched to a Korean branch

#### Required documents

② A Statement of Invitation
③ A document demonstrating you are a highly required specialist (i.e. resume, a certificate of employment history)

question: i left korea in february 2022 with a re-entry permit and because of covid i cant get back before it runs out. what am i supposed to do?
reference: Registered foreigners who left before April 1, 2022 with a re-entry permit should enter within the granted re-entry permit period (within 1 year). If entering within that period is difficult because of COVID-19, they should visit a Korean diplomatic mission abroad to extend the re-entry permit period.
answer: Registered foreigners who departed before April 1, 2022, with a Re-entry Permit should visit a Korean diplomatic mission abroad to extend the re-entry permit period in case entering the ROK within the relevant period is difficult due to COVID-19 [1, 3].

passages.snippet:
- 1 - Announcement Regarding Re-Entry Permit Reimplementation of Re-Entry Permit Exemption as of April 1, 2022 after suspension due to COVID-19 The Re-Entry Permit Exemption which has been suspended since June 1, 2020 will be reimplemented as of April 1, 2022 according to changes in COVID response in the nation.
◎ With the re-implementation of the nation’s Re-Entry Permit Exemption, registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 will be allowed re-entry into the ROK within 1 year (2 years for permanent residents)
from the date of departure, without obtaining a Re-entry Permit in advance.
◎ Yet, registered foreign residents intending to re-enter the Republic of Korea after spending more than a year abroad from the date of departure should apply for a Multiple Re-entry Permit (granted for up to 2 years)

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Person who plans to visit Korea for tour or transit without a visa

#### Visa Free Entry Guide
Visa is a fundamental requirement to enter the Republic of Korea, and in principle, foreigners must have valid visas when they travel. However, those who fall under any of the following categories below are allowed to enter Korea without visas. (Article 7(2) of the Immigration Act)
-
-
-
-
-

-
Even if the foreigner has the valid visa or is subject to visa-free entry, he/she may be denied entry to the Republic of Korea if he's found inadmissible by an immigration officer at the port of entry.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)
### Re-Entry Permit Holders
-
Re-entry permit holders refer to those who have obtained re-entry permits or those who are exempted from obtaining re-entry permits arriving in Korea before the expiry dates

question: For a D-8-1 visa where the investment was made in kind rather than in cash, which documents show the transfer of the investment capital?

citations.title: Visa guide: D-8-1 Incorporated Enterprise
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A required professional who plans to engage in a manufacturing·technical or management·administration at a foreign-invested Korean corporation in ROK in accordance with the 「Foreign Investment Promotion Act」

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

An indispensable skilled worker dispatched by a foreign company which has invested in the ROK in accordance with regulations of the 「Foreign Investment Promotion Act」, and who plans to engage in management, administration, production, or technology at the foreign company

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A dispatch order indicating the period of a dispatch and a certificate of employment
③ A Foreign Investment Notification form or A copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
④ A copy of Business Registration Certificate, a copy of unabridged corporate registration, an original copy of a statement demonstrating the change of shareholders
⑤ Documents demonstrating a transfer of investment capitals
Case A. Investment in Cash
- A permission of a foreign currency transfer, or a confirmation of foreign currency remittance issued by the respective customs service or a bank (or a financial institution) of a respective country
- A statement of investment funds such as a confirmation of foreign currency transfer, a certificate of purchased foreign currency, a customs declaration form and others
Case B. Investment in Kind
- A copy of Confirmation of Completion of In-Kind Investment issued by the head of Korean Customs Service
- A copy of Customs Import Declaration Certificate
⑥ Additional documents for private investors who has invested less than 300 million KRW
- Documents demonstrating an initial capital such as a receipt for the purchased goods, costs of office interior, a bank statement
- Documents verifying the existence of business (i.e. an office lease contract, photos of an office in a front and an inside view, a street sign of a company or others)
- Documents proving work or entrepreneurial experiences from an applicant's country.

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who plans to work at an foreign invested corporation in accordance with the regulations of the 「Foreign Investment Promotion Act」 (for only those dispatched to ROK)

- The investment target must be a Korean corporation (including the ones that are in the midst of establishment process).
- The amount of investment must be at least 100 million KRW, and you must either have at least 10 percent of the total capital stocks of the company in addition to the voting right (Paragraph 1, Article 2(2) of the Foreign Investment Promotion Act) or sign a contract of dispatching and appointing executives by having some stock shares (Paragraph 2, Article 2(2) of the Foreign Investment Promotion Act)

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A dispatch order indicating the period of a dispatch and a certificate of employment
③ A Foreign Investment Notification form or A copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
④ A copy of Business Registration Certificate, a copy of unabridged corporate registration, an original copy of a statement demonstrating the change of shareholders
⑤ Documents demonstrating a transfer of investment capitals
Case A. Investment in Cash
- A permission of a foreign currency transfer, or a confirmation of foreign currency remittance issued by the respective customs service or a bank (or a financial institution) of a respective country
- A statement of investment funds such as a confirmation of foreign currency transfer, a certificate of purchased foreign currency, a customs declaration form and others
Case B. Investment in Kind
- A copy of Confirmation of Completion of In-Kind Investment issued by the head of Korean Customs Service
- A copy of Customs Import Declaration Certificate
⑥ Additional documents for private investors who has invested less than 300 million KRW
- Documents demonstrating an initial capital such as a receipt for the purchased goods, costs of office interior, a bank statement
- Documents verifying the existence of business (i.e. an office lease contract, photos of an office in a front and an inside view, a street sign of a company or others)
- Documents proving work or entrepreneurial experiences from an applicant’s country.

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

question: Under the April 2022 re-entry permit exemption, until when may a registered foreigner whose period of stay is less than 1 year re-enter Korea without a re-entry permit?
reference: Until the end of the validity of their stay (their authorised period of stay).
answer: Registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022, are allowed re-entry into the ROK within 1 year from the date of departure without obtaining a Re-entry Permit in advance [1, 2]. For those with a period of stay of less than 1 year, re-entry is allowed until the validity of stay [2, 3, 5].

question: im putting about 200 million won into a business with a korean co-founder and ive never run a business before. does that cause any problem for the D-8-3 visa?
reference: Investors of less than 300 million KRW must submit additional documents (proof of initial capital such as receipts and bank statements, proof that the business exists such as an office lease and photos, and proof of work or entrepreneurial experience in their own country). Private investors of less than 300 million KRW with no entrepreneurial experience will be closely reviewed.
answer: Private investors who have invested less than 300 million KRW and have no entrepreneurial experiences will be closely reviewed [1].

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A required professional who plans to engage in the manufacturing·technical or management·administration area of a foreign-invested company run by a Korean National(individual) in accordance with the 「Foreign Investment Promotion Act」

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person whose name is registered as a co-founder of a company run by Korean(individual) after investing in the company in accordance with the Foreign Investment Promotion Act

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A Foreign Investment Notification form or A copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
③ Usage statement of start up capitals from Korean co-founder.
④ Original copy of Business Partnership Agreement and A copy of Business Registration Certificate on which the name of co-founder is written
⑤ Documents demonstrating a transfer of investment capitals
Case A. Investment in Cash
- A permission of a foreign currency transfer, or a confirmation of foreign currency remittance issued by the respective customs service or a bank (or a financial institution) of a respective country
- A statement of investment funds such as a confirmation of foreign currency transfer, a certificate of purchased foreign currency, a customs declaration form and others
Case B. Investment in Kind
- A copy of Confirmation of Completion of In-Kind Investment issued by the head of Korean Customs Service
- A copy of Customs Import Declaration Certificate
⑥ Additional documents for private investors who has invested less than 300 million KRW
- Documents demonstrating an initial capital such as a receipt for the purchased goods, costs of office interior, a bank statement
- Documents verifying the existence of business (i.e. an office lease contract, photos of an office in a front and an inside view, a street sign of a company or others)
- Documents proving work or entrepreneurial experiences from an applicant’s country.
※ Private investors who have invested less than 300 million KRW and have no entrepreneurial experiences will be closely reviewed.

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: In the declaration of accommodation scheme for short-term foreign residents, from what crisis alert level under the Act on Counter-terrorism for the Protection of Citizens and Public Security is declaration required?
reference: From the "caution" level or higher.
answer: Declaration is required in the issuance of a crisis alert of the "caution" level or higher in line with the "Act On Counter-terrorism For The Protection Of Citizens And Public Security" [1].

citations.title: Introducing declaration of accommodation by short-term foreign residents
citations.snippet:
Declaration of accommodation by short-term foreign residents Visit Hi Korea website (www.hikorea.go.kr) or a dedicated website set up for this scheme (www.k-eta.go.kr/trds) for more information.
This schemes aims to minimise social/economic loss and ensure safety of the public by locating short-term residents' accommodation in a timely manner should a communicable disease outbreak or a terrorist attack takes place.
* Alerts are classified into four levels, namely: attention, caution, alert, and serious.
Declaration is required in the issuance of a crisis alert* of the "interest" level or higher in line with "Infectious Disease Control And Prevention Act" or in the issuance of a crisis alert* of the "caution" level of higher in line with "Act On Counter-terrorism For The Protection Of Citizens And Public Security".
Foreign residents holding short-term visas- B-1(Visa exempted), B-2(Tourism/transit), C-1(Short-term news coverage), C-3(Short-term visit), C-4(Short-term employment)
should present passport or a travel document to the owner of the accommodation facility.
A breach of this requirement will result in a fine up to KRW 500,000.
Accommodation facilities registed as a lodging business in line with Public Health Control Act or tourist accommodation business, city home-stay services for foreign tourists or Hanok experience business in line with Tourism Promotion Act should relay information of foreign guest (e.g. passport information)
via an information network designated by the Ministry of Justice.
A breach of this requirement will result in a fine up to KRW 500,000.
went into force as of 10 December 2020 as a measure to prevent the spread of communicable disease in the country

passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to visit for a short-term employment such as temporary show, advertising·modeling, lecturing·speeching, research, technology consulting, etc.

## Embassy visa application
### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A service provider who has been dispatched to the Republic of Korea based on a various services contract and who earns wages, including living expenses, from a government-owned company or a private corporation

※ Manual labor does not qualify for a Short-term Employee (C-4) visa.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of your service contract
③ A dispatch order or a proof of overseas assignment

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 months under the Visa Exemption Agreement between two countries.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

## Embassy visa application
### Embassy visa application — Case 4

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who is applicable for a Professor(E-1) visa or a Foreign National of Special Ability (E-7) visa, and plans to give a lecture, give public speeches, or research for less than 90 days on the basis of a contract for profits as an expert in a particular area or a university instructor
※ If the lecturer or speaker is not compensated other than flight and accommodation, he/she is eligible for a Short-term General (C-3-1) visa.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An employment contract (on providing lectures·public speeches) or an invitation card that indicates lecture fees and others (a document of request for visa issuance cooperation)
③ A copy of degree certificate and proof of employment
④ A document related to the establishment of an inviting academic institution (a copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register and others)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 months under the Visa Exemption Agreement between two countries.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to stay for a short period of time on the purpose of visiting relatives, investing in public business, participating in a non-official sport games, attending events or meetings, performing cultural art, engaging in a training, taking lessons, attending a religious ceremony, collecting documents for academic research, or any other equivalent activities.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A foreign investor, or an executive and a stockholder of a corporate that has invested a substantial amount of capital in the investment facilities, and who wishes to frequently travel to the ROK without alien registration, and his/her accompanied family members (parents, a spouse, children, parents-in-law)

#### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② Certified copy of real estate register, a real-estate contract (for a person registered)
③ Membership certificate confirmed and issued by the Korea Leisure Condominium Management Association, membership certificate and deposit receipt issued by the selling company (for members only)
④ Certificate of foreign exchange purchase (a receipt of wire transfer to ROK, proof of money transfer or other documents indicating that you have brought foreign capitals to ROK)
⑤ Additional document to prove payment or remittance from overseas (under corresponding investor’s name) to the corporate
⑥ Official letter from the respective company, which indicates that you are a member of their current executive body or oligopolistic stockholder. You also need the entire list of their executives and stockholders (for executives or stockholders of the company only)
⑦ A certificate of family relations (only when you apply for accompanying family)

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A retired foreign investor, or an executive or a stockholder of a corporate that has invested a substantial amount of capital in the investment target designated by the Minister of Justice, and who wishes to frequently travel to the ROK without alien registration, and his/her accompanied family members (parents, a spouse, children, parents-in-law)

#### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② Any documents proving that you have paid an applicant's investment money (investment confirmation stamped by the head of an investment-attracting agency, wire transfer receipt, and etc.)
③ A document demonstrating foreign exchange purchase or a record of capitals inflow to ROK for business operation, or a record of fund being wire-transferred to ROK.
④ Family Relations Certificate (limited to a case where spouse of investor or minor children, parents apply for the visa)
⑤ For Retired immigrant investors(over age 55), documents demonstrating their financial assets worth at least 300 million KRW (i.e. deposits, assets such as real estate)
⑥ Official letter from the respective company, which indicates that you are a member of their current executive body or oligopolistic stockholder. You also need the entire list of their executives and stockholders (for executives or stockholders of the company only)

※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

#### Visa validity and period of stay

question: An overseas Korean with foreign nationality is 62 years old. Can they get a C-3-8 short-term visa for overseas Koreans, and which F-4 category covers someone of their age?
reference: No. The C-3-8 is for overseas Koreans with foreign nationality below the age of 60. The F-4-25 (Person of Age 60 or older) covers overseas Koreans aged 60 or older with the nationality of a country notified by the Minister of Justice.
answer: A person who is an overseas Korean with a foreign nationality and 62 years old is not eligible for a C-3-8 Short term Visitor (Overseas Korean) visa because that visa is for those below the age of 60 [1]. The F-4-25 Person of Age 60 or older category covers an overseas Korean with a foreign nationality of a country notified by the Minister of Justice of ROK who is 60 years or older [2].

question: For an E-10-2 fishing ship crew Confirmation of Visa Issuance, who issues the Certificate of Report on Foreign Crew Employment, and when must the fishery license and fishing boat certificate be submitted?
reference: The certificate is issued by the head of the local Maritime Affairs & Port Administration. The fishery license, fishing boat certificate and coastal fishing license copy are submitted only by first-time applicants or when the registration information is changing.
answer: The Certificate of Report on Foreign Crew Employment is issued by the head of local Maritime Affairs & Port Administration [1]. The fishery license and a certificate of fishing boat must be submitted only if you are a first time applier or wish to change the registration information [1].

citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who is a seafarer assistant and has signed a seafarer labor contract of 6 months or more with an employer engaging in a business (operating fishing vessel of 20 tons or heavier) in accordance with the Regulation on Fixed net Fishery and Inshore Fishery using Motor Vessel

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A sailor who falls under the provisions of Article 2(6) of the Seafarers Act, who has signed a seafarer labor contract of 6 months or more with an employer engaging in a business( a ship of 20 tons or heavier) defined in Sub-section (1) of Article 8(1) [Fixed net Fishery] and sub-section (1) of Article 43(1) [ Inshore Fishery using Motor Vessel] of the Fishery Act

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A copy standard labor contract
③ A letter of guarantee
④ A Certificate of Report on Foreign Crew Employment issued by the head of local Maritime Affairs ＆ Port Administration
⑤ An employment recommendation letter
⑥ A fishery license and a certificate of fishing boat, a copy of coastal fishing license in accordance with the Fishery Act.
Please submit the document only if you are a first time applier or wish to change the registration information.
⑦ A copy of Ship Inspection Report

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

question: im mexican and i was planning to visit korea in may 2020. did the april 2020 suspension mean i needed a visa?
reference: No. Mexico was one of the 10 visa-waiver countries still eligible for visa-free entry after April 13, 2020.
answer: As of April 13, 2020, Mexico was one of the 56 visa-waiver countries subject to temporary suspension measures [1]. Accordingly, persons with a passport from Mexico were required to obtain a visa from a Korean diplomatic mission to enter the Republic of Korea [1].

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Person who plans to visit Korea for tour or transit without a visa

#### Visa Free Entry Guide
Visa is a fundamental requirement to enter the Republic of Korea, and in principle, foreigners must have valid visas when they travel. However, those who fall under any of the following categories below are allowed to enter Korea without visas. (Article 7(2) of the Immigration Act)
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
Even if the foreigner has the valid visa or is subject to visa-free entry, he/she may be denied entry to the Republic of Korea if he's found inadmissible by an immigration officer at the port of entry.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)
### Tourists in transit to Third Countries (* Temporarily Suspended due to COVID-19)

#### 1. Eligible Applicants
-
Nationals of countries, except for the 24 xecluded countries (Syria, Sudan, Iran, Macedonia, Cuba, Republic Of Kosovo, Palestine, Afghanistan, Iraq, Nigeria, Ghana, Yemen, Gambia, Senegal, Bangladesh, Kyrgyzstan, Pakistan, Somalia, Uzbekistan, Nepal, Cameron, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Egypt) that are not granted visa free entry into Korea.
-
(a) Persons who hold a visa to the United States(including Guam and Saipan), Canada, Australia, or New Zealand, who transit through Korea to enter the abovementioned countries; or (b) persons who stayed in and departed from one of the abovementioned countries and transit through Korea bound for the country of origin or a third country.
-
(a) Persons who hold a visa (or permanent residency) to at least one of the 30 European countires (Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Latvia, Rumania, Luxemburg, Lithuania, Liechtenstein, Malta, Belgium, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Slovenia, Iceland, Ireland, Estonia, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech, Cyprus, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, Hungary), who transit through Korea bound for one of the 30 European countries; or (b) persons who departed from one of the 30 European countries, transit through Korea bound for the country of origin or a third country.

#### 2. Requirements
-
Persons who hold a visa (re-entry permit, permanent residency, etc.) to enter the United States, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand (hereinafter referred to as “the four advanced countries”) and
-
1) who go to one of the four advanced countries in transit through Korea; or
-
2) who stay in one of the four advanced countries and take a direct flight from the country to Korea to go to a country of nationality or a third country.
-
Please be noted that:
-
- If you are a U.S. visa holder who transit through Korea and Saipan to reach the U.S. as the final destination, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. (However, if you depart from the U.S. and enter Korea via Saipan, you are not granted no-visa entry to Korea.)
-
- If you are a Chinese group tourist holding a group-tourist visa to Japan and meet certain requirements (e.g. using a travel agency that only attracts Chinese group tourists), you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa.
-
- If you hold an e-visa to Australia and a visa label is attached to your passport, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. However, if the label is not on your passport, you are granted no-visa entry only when you depart from Australia and transit through Korea.

#### 3. Condition of Permission
-
You have a confirmed onward flight ticket for departure within 30 days after entering Korea, in addition to having no record of criminal offence such as overstay in the countries mentioned above
-
You had not been denied entry into Korea, or had not been fined more than 5 million KRW or not have been forcibly evicted or received a deportation order for violation of law in the past 3 years preceding the date of entry
-
You stayed no more than 3 days in the country of transit or stopover. (But, Not applicable when the person is returning to the immediate previous point of departure(country of transit or stopover)
-
For hloders of U.S., Canada, Australia, or New Zealand e-visas, a visa sticker must be attached to the passport; if unattached, visa free entry will be applicable when departing from the 4 countries mentioned above bound for the country of origin or a third country.

question: For an E-6-1 artist who will perform under the Performance Act, which performance-specific documents are required for Confirmation of Visa Issuance?
reference: A performance recommendation letter from the Korea Media Rating Board and an outline of the performance. (The guide adds that if the performance is not recommended, the applicant is exempt from submitting the letter.)
answer: The required performance-specific documents are a performance recommendation letter from the Korea Media Rating Board and an outline of performance [1]. An applicant is exempt from submitting the performance recommendation letter if their performance is not recommended [1].

A person who plans to engage in profitable activities such as music, fine arts, and literature, or professional acting, or professional entertainment activities in accordance with the Public Performance Act

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who plans to engage in for-profit musical, artistic, literature, or entertainment activities designated by the Performance Act. < Other cases >

A person who plans to engage in profitable activities such as music, fine arts, and literature, or professional acting, or professional entertainment activities in accordance with the Public Performance Act

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who plans to engage in for-profit musical, artistic, literature, or entertainment activities designated by the Performance Act. (i.e. composer, painter, photographer and others artist, a member of orchestra and conductor, advertising·fashion model, badook(go) player, broadcaster, entertainer, theatrical actors/actress, makeup artists)

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A copy of Business Registration Certificate
③ A copy of employment contract

< If you are going to perform in accordance with the Performance Act >

⑤ An outline of performance

< Other cases >

Declaration of accommodation by short-term foreign residents Visit Hi Korea website (www.hikorea.go.kr) or a dedicated website set up for this scheme (www.k-eta.go.kr/trds) for more information.
This schemes aims to minimise social/economic loss and ensure safety of the public by locating short-term residents' accommodation in a timely manner should a communicable disease outbreak or a terrorist attack takes place.

Foreign residents holding short-term visas- B-1(Visa exempted), B-2(Tourism/transit), C-1(Short-term news coverage), C-3(Short-term visit), C-4(Short-term employment)

via an information network designated by the Ministry of Justice.
A breach of this requirement will result in a fine up to KRW 500,000.

passages.snippet:
【 Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System 】 This is to announce that Re-entry Permit System will change as specified below as all entrants from overseas are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate starting January 8 (Fri.), 2021 in response to recent spread of the highly transmissible new coronavirus strains.
□ Mandatory submission of negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate by foreigners issued with Re-entry Permit
• (Current) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR certificate, a medical certificate, or a medical examination exemption certificate.
• (After the Change) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate.
- A negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate is deemed valid only when issued within 72 hours prior to departure.
※ Application for ‘Medical Examination Exemption Certificate’ for Re-entry Permit is no longer available.
□ Date of Enforcement
• All foreigners entering the ROK are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate as of 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.
- Foreigners with a Re-entry Permit (including those exempted from medical examination) issued before January 8 (Fri.), 2021 are also required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate if entering the nation after 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.

- About 1.1 million chinese group tourists were granted a Japanese group tourist visa in 2014. The no-visa entry is expected to provide Chinese tourists travelling Japan with easier and convenient access to Korea so that they can enjoy tourism activities while staying in the country for a maximum of 15 days.

❍ The above measures were designed to dispel public concerns over the tourism industry following the MERS outbreak and to support foreigners with easier and convenient access to Korea. The Ministry of Justice expects the measures to contribute to revitalizing the tourism industry and the Korean economy.

question: What size of manufacturer can hire a worker on the E-9-1 manufacturing visa?
reference: A manufacturer with fewer than 300 full-time workers or capital of less than 8 billion KRW.
answer: A manufacturer with less than 300 full-time workers or capital worth less than 8 billion KRW can hire a worker on this visa [1].

question: For an E-9-2 construction worker's Confirmation of Visa Issuance, who prepares the required list of foreign employees at the construction site, and how long a period of stay is granted?
reference: The construction company (prime contractor) responsible for the construction site prepares the list. The period of stay is granted for up to 3 years.
answer: The list of foreign employees working at a construction site is prepared by a construction company (prime contractor) responsible for the construction site [1]. Periods of stay will be granted for up to 3 years [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: E-9-2 Construction
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who meets the employment requirements defined in the Employment of Foreign Workers Act and plans to work in construction industry

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who meets employment requirements in accordance with the provisions of the Act on Foreign Workers' Employment, who plans to work for a construction company in ROK ( However, a construction company at a construction site of power plant, steelwork, or petrochemical plant, and has a construction license for an Industrial and Environmental Facility Construction, is excluded. )

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A copy of Business Registration Certificate
③ A copy of Employment Permit and a copy of Standard Labor Contract
④ A report of workplace assessment
⑤ A copy of Construction Business Registration, a certified copy of Corporate Register and a copy of Construction Contract(Subcontract)
⑥ A list of foreign employees working at a construction site prepared by a construction company (prime contractor) responsible for the construction site

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 3 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

question: i got my degree from a korean university. for the E-2-1 english teacher visa do i still need to get my degree copy apostilled?
reference: No. If the degree is from a university in Korea, an un-authenticated copy of the degree is accepted.
answer: If you have a degree from a university in ROK, an un-authenticated copy of a degree will also be accepted [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: E-2-1 Foreign Language Instructor (General)
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who meets the qualifications determined by the Minister of Justice, and plans to teach conversational language at a foreign language institute, affiliated- language research institute or educational institute of higher than elementary school, or language training institute affiliated with an enterprise or broadcasting company, or other equivalent organization.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. An instructor at an English Academy
- A person who teaches a foreign language in accordance with Article 3(3) of the presidential decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Private Teaching Institutes and Extracurricular Lessons
2. An instructor who is recruited/selected by an academic institution such as elementary school (or higher) or an affiliated language center
3. A foreign language instructor at corporate language centers for employee on-the-job-training
4. A foreign language instructor at a continuing education institute in accordance with the Lifelong Education Act
* School affiliated continuing education facilities, school·company's internal college·cyber university, business places· civil society groups· media affiliated continuing education facilities, continuing education related to knowledge·human resource development
5. A foreign language instructor teaching at a continuing education facility that is established and run by the state or other local governments in accordance with other laws (including regulations)
6. A foreign language instructor teaching at a vocational skills development facility or vocational training corporation established in accordance with the Workers Vocational Skills Development Act
7. A foreign language instructor teaching at a corporation or a public institute* which has set up a language center that has all the necessary equipment and facilities to study a foreign language for its employees

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A proof of an applicant's education authenticated by a public authority*.
Please, choose one from below to submit;
A copy of a degree, a copy of diploma, a graduation certificate indicating an acquisition of a degree
*The document needs to be authenticated by the Hague Apostille Convention(for a signatory of the convention), by consular officers of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad (for not a signatory of the convention), or by an official public institute in Korea (i.e. Korean Council for University Education), or by a government agency of applicants(Japanese only)
- If you have a degree from a university in ROK, an un-authenticated copy of a degree will also be accepted.
- If you have a history of submitting a document authenticated by the institutes listed above, you are exempt from the requirement.
③ A criminal record issued and authenticated by a public authority* in an applicant's country
* The document needs to be authenticated under the Hague Apostille Convention(for a signatory of the convention), by consular officers of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad (for not a signatory of the convention), or by consular officers of a foreign embassy in Korea (for a foreign resident in Korea)
- The criminal records that includes all criminal records across the country, must be issued within 6 months from the application date.
- If you have a history of submitting a criminal record authenticated by a public authority, staying and leaving ROK, and re-apply within 3 months from the last departure from ROK, you are exempt from submitting the document. However, if it has been more than 3 months since the last departure, you need to re-submit it when applying for an alien registration.
④ A Self-Assessment Report on Heath
⑤ An employment contract, and a document of the establishment of an academic institute or an organization
⑥ Other necessary documents for evaluation
- an outline of teachers management, a document suggesting the total number of students and faculties

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 2 years.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 2 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

question: im doing a phd in korea and have been here 8 months. can my parents come on the F-1-15 visa, and is there anything extra if more than three family members would be with me?
reference: Yes. Parents of a foreign student enrolled in a master's or doctoral programme in Korea who has stayed 6 months or more are eligible. If the accompanying family members, including the invitees, are more than three, the student must prove at least 50% of the previous year's per capita GNI for annual living expenses, in addition to tuition.
answer: You are eligible to apply for the F-1-15 visa as a student because you are enrolled in a master's/doctoral program in Korea and have stayed in the country for 6 months or more [1]. If more than three family members (including invitees) accompany you, you must prove that you have at least 50% of the per capita GNI of the previous year in Korea for annual living expenses in addition to tuition [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: F-1-15 Parents of Foreign Talents, etc
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A parent of a foreign talent, investor, student and their spouse

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A parent of a person satisfying the following requirements and a parent of the person's spouse
① (foreign talent) a Long-term News Coverage (D-5), Intra-Company Transferee (D-7), Corporate/Foreign Investor (D-8), International Trade (D-9), and from Professor (E-1) to Foreign National of Special Ability (E-7) visa holder whose annual income is twice per capita GNI of the previous year or more
- Including a person who has changed his/her status of stay to F-2, F-5, etc. while maintaining the same activities falling under the above statuses
- However, if you change your status of stay to the above statuses (D-5, D-7, D-8, D-9 or E-1 - E-7) after earning a bachelor's degree or higher in Korea, the minimum annual income requirement is lowered to per capita GNI of the previous year or more.
② (investor) a registered foreigner who has invested 300 million KRW in Korea and stayed in the country for 6 months or more in accordance with the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, the Foreign Exchange Transaction Act and the Immigrant Investor Scheme.
③ (student) a foreign student enrolled in a master's/doctoral program of Korea who has stayed in the country for 6 months or more
- However, if the accompanying family members including invitees are more than three, they should prove that they have at least 50％ of per capita GNI of the previous year in Korea for annual living expenses in addition to tuition.

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A copy of inviter's Alien Registration Card, a reference letter, a statement of invitation (suggesting that the invitee would not seek a job), documents proving the place of residence
③ Documents proving family relations
※ A Marriage Certificate, a certificate on family relations or a Birth Certificate
④ Documents proving inviter's income/invested money/living expenses

※ If you hire a representative, you must submit a power of Attorney, the proof of current employment status of your representative, and a photocopy of your representative IDs
※ The head of Immigration Office may request additional documents if it is deemed necessary to examine the purpose of entry, the genuineness of the invitation, and the qualifications of the inviter and the invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months. Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

question: What is the minimum number of tourists a group must have to apply for a group e-visa?
reference: Not in the corpus. The group e-visa regulation only defines a group visa as one for groups whose members exceed the number prescribed by the Minister of Justice, without stating that number.
answer: The number of members must exceed the number prescribed by the Minister of Justice [3].

question: For an F-1-24 household assistant of a professional, how high must the employer's income be?
reference: More than three times the previous year's gross national income (GNI) as announced by the Bank of Korea.
answer: The employer's income should be three times more than gross national income (GNI) of the previous year announced by the Bank of Korea [1].

question: my mom is korean and she remarried. im her foreign minor kid applying for F-2-2 at the embassy under case 1. whose letters of guarantee do we need?

A minor child of Korean, or a child born from a marriage of which an either of parents is Korean (including de facto marriage) and recognized by the Minister of Justice of ROK

## Embassy visa application

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A foreign minor child of a Korean parent

① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
