passages.title: The Ministry of Justice's Measures to Provide Convenient Entry to Foreign Tourists
passages.snippet:
- 1 - Press Release Embargoed until July 1, 2015 14:00 pm 2 pages Date July 1, 2015 Division Visa & Residence Division Director Kim, Young-guen
02) 2110-4055 Deputy Director Chang, Hee-jung
02) 2110-4067 Picture with pictures □ without pictures ■ Office of Spokesperson 02) 2110-3717 The Ministry of Justice's Measures to Provide Convenient Entry to Foreign Tourists
- Exemption of Visa Application Fees for Group Tourists
- Extension of Visa Expiration Date
- Expansion of No-visa Entry
❍ The Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea has decided to implement proactive measures such as exemption of visa application fees in order to provide foreign tourists with easier and convenient access to Korea and thereby support the concerned tourism industry following the recent Middle East Respiratory Syndrome (MERS) outbreak.
❍ The measures include:
1. First, exemption of visa application fees for group tourists from China and other countries for three months (from July 6 to September 30)
- Visa application fees for Chinese group tourists (currently about 15 US dollars per person) are exempt for three months to support attracting foreign tourists.
- The same exemption measure applies to four Southeast Asian countries (Vietnam, Philippines, Indonesia and Cambodia) to which group tourist visas
- 2 - are issued.
2. Second, validity extension of single-entry visas that were issued before and after the MERS development (from March 1 to June 30, 2015) from the current three months to six months
- Persons subject to the extension are allowed to enter the Republic of Korea even after the visa expiration date, which would prevent them from going through inconvenient procedures such as visiting a diplomatic mission to have their visa extended.
Note: About 1.09 million foreigners were granted a single-entry visa from March to June 2015. The Ministry will promote relevant information through diplomatic missions in China and other countries so that foreigners can benefit from it.
3. Third, no-visa entry for Chinese group tourists holding a Japanese group tourist visa
- About 1.1 million chinese group tourists were granted a Japanese group tourist visa in 2014. The no-visa entry is expected to provide Chinese tourists travelling Japan with easier and convenient access to Korea so that they can enjoy tourism activities while staying in the country for a maximum of 15 days.
- At the same time, the Ministry will prepare restrictive measures to eliminate concerns over illegal stays of tourists that may be caused by the implementation of the measure in order to minimize possible side effects.
❍ The above measures were designed to dispel public concerns over the tourism industry following the MERS outbreak and to support foreigners with easier and convenient access to Korea. The Ministry of Justice expects the measures to contribute to revitalizing the tourism industry and the Korean economy.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Person who plans to engage in commercial activities such as market research, business meetings, consultation, signing a contract, or small-scale international trading or an APEC card holder visiting Korea without a visa

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

a person who plans to stay for a short period of time in ROK for the purposes of market research, liaison works, counseling, signing a contract, or installing/repairing/learning to operate an imported/exported machinery, or other similar reasons

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A document proving the purpose of your business such as a business invitation letter, a copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of Corporate Register

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months or a double-entry visa valid for 6 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days for a single-entry visa , and 30 days for a double-entry visa.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year,
if you have visited the ROK or any OECD member country for one time and with no criminal and illegal immigration records

□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years, if you are
1) A professional that requires a license recognized by a government such as doctor, lawyer, accountant, and others.
2) A faculty member positioned higher than an assistant professor at university (or vocational college), a teacher of elementary, middle, or high school
3) Famous artists, entertainers and athletes acknowledged by the head of Korean diplomatic mission abroad
4) A person who has visited ROK as a group-tourist guide at a travel agency specialized in group tourists
* It refers to a tourist guide at a travel agency specialized in only assisting group tourists assembled by a designated travel agency only in contrast to a tourist guide of a group tourist agency in general.
5) A person who has visited the ROK or OECD member countries more than two times and has no criminal or illegal immigration records. (*Entry based on visa exemption or as a group tourist to Jeju is NOT counted as the number of visit to ROK)
6) A person who has visited the ROK with a Medical Tourist visa
7) A person who has proved his/her assets including real estate, financial assets, or business ownership worth more than 5,000,000 yuan
8) A public/civil servant of China
9) An executive or an employee of a corporate which has invested more than $1,000,000 (or approximately 1,000,000,000 KRW) in the Republic of Korea
10) An executive or an employee of an airline or a shipping company providing services to the ROK
11) A VIP customer of an internationally-accepted credit card company with the granted level above Gold-Card
12) A person whose monthly income is more than 5,000 yuan (or an annual income of 60,000 yuan)
13) A retiree aged 55 or older who has collected his/her pension
14) An elementary, middle, or high school student, or a student, or a graduate from the listed universities on the 211 project
* Please check the website at http://www.moe.edu.cn/edoas/website18/51/info1207097171157851.htm
15) An employee or manager (or higher) who has been working for more than 6 months at a listed company from the 500 major corporations selected by Chinese Company Association
* Please check the website http://www.cec-ceda.org.cn
16) A person who has purchased a membership card (worth more than 30,000,000 KRW) of a condominium located in Korea*
* verified through a certificate of tax payment of acquisition
17) Parents, Parents-In-Law, Unmarried Child*, Spouse of a valid multiple-entry C-3 visa holder
* A person with multiple nationalities must follow the Guidelines of People with Multiple Nationalities except for a multiple-entry C-3-8 visa holder
18) Registered residents of Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen, who possess the new household registration record containing a tamperproof embedded chip * Those who do not have the new household registration record can present their passport, resident identity card, and old household registration record.
19) an executive of a private enterprise whose annual trade with ROK is worth US$30,000 or more, or a person who has worked for a respective company as a full-time employee for more than 2 years.

□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years,
if you have previously received a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years and have no criminal and illegal immigration records.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Two different documents proving your identity and financial ability to support yourself during the stay in ROK

[ Examples of Documents Proving Your Identity and Financial Ability ]
Proof of employment, credit card statement within the past 6 months, Certificate of Social Insurance Registration, Tax Clearance Certificate, Degree Certificate, Permanent Residence Certificate, Invitation Letter from a specific institution, a document proving that you have collected your pension, proof of employment verifying you have worked as an executive member or a full-time employee at a respective company, records of international trade with ROK

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
A multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year, 3 years, or 5 years will be issued to an eligible applicant.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 30 days.

## E-visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who has been invited by the local company(inviter) for commercial purpose, with history of entering Korea for more than 3 times as short-term visitor(C-3) visa since Jan. 1st, 2012.
※ She/he must not have any history of illegal stay or criminal case during the period of stay.

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form, a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An Invitation Letter including the purpose of an invitation and an agreement that guarantees the return of a patient
③ A copy of ID Card of an inviting person

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days.

19) an executive of a private enterprise whose annual trade with ROK is worth US$30,000 or more, or a person who has worked for a respective company as a full-time employee for more than 2 years.

□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years,
if you have previously received a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years and have no criminal and illegal immigration records.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Two different documents proving your identity and financial ability to support yourself during the stay in ROK

[ Examples of Documents Proving Your Identity and Financial Ability ]
Proof of employment, credit card statement within the past 6 months, Certificate of Social Insurance Registration, Tax Clearance Certificate, Degree Certificate, Permanent Residence Certificate, Invitation Letter from a specific institution, a document proving that you have collected your pension, proof of employment verifying you have worked as an executive or a full-time employee at a respective company, records of international trade with ROK

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
A multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year, 3 years, or 5 years will be issued to an eligible applicant.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 30 days.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application
### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A retired foreign investor, or an executive or a stockholder of a corporate that has invested a substantial amount of capital in the investment target designated by the Minister of Justice, and who wishes to frequently travel to the ROK without alien registration, and his/her accompanied family members (parents, a spouse, children, parents-in-law)

#### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② Any documents proving that you have paid an applicant's investment money (investment confirmation stamped by the head of an investment-attracting agency, wire transfer receipt, and etc.)
③ A document demonstrating foreign exchange purchase or a record of capitals inflow to ROK for business operation, or a record of fund being wire-transferred to ROK.
④ Family Relations Certificate (limited to a case where spouse of investor or minor children, parents apply for the visa)
⑤ For Retired immigrant investors(over age 55), documents demonstrating their financial assets worth at least 300 million KRW (i.e. deposits, assets such as real estate)
⑥ Official letter from the respective company, which indicates that you are a member of their current executive body or oligopolistic stockholder. You also need the entire list of their executives and stockholders (for executives or stockholders of the company only)

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

## E-visa application
### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are
A person (i.e. corporate executive and stockholder) who has signed an investment contract with a promotion agency of the Immigrant Investor Scheme for Public Business to make the minimum investments required or more in the public funds or projects designated by the Minister of Justice and wants to visit the Republic of Korea at the invitation of the agency and, who meets one of the following two requirements and his/her accompanying family members (i.e. spouse and unmarried children)

1. Payment of at least a third of the total fees to the agency
2. Remittance or deposit of investment money of at least KRW 50 million in Korea

question: For an F-4-12 descendant of an overseas Korean, what can be submitted if the applicant cannot submit the family relations certificate, Certificate of Removal from Family Registry or closed register?
reference: Other documents such as a certificate of birth, discharge or death that prove the overseas Korean with foreign citizenship or the family relationship.
answer: If you cannot submit a certification of the family relations record, Certificate of Removal from Family Registry or closed Register, you can submit any documents such as certificate of birth, discharge, and death for proving Overseas Koreans with foreign citizenship or family relations [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: F-4-12 Descendant of Overseas Korean
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person whose parent or grandparent was Korean but has acquired nationality of a country other than the countries notified by the Minister of Justice of ROK

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person whose parent or grandparent had a Korean Nationality and has acquired a foreign nationality

### Required documents
1. Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
2. Documents proving that your immediate family member once had a Korean nationality
- Certificate of Family Registry, Certificate of Removal from Family Registry or closed Register and other documents proving that your immediate family member had a Korean nationality
※ If you can not submit certification of the family relations record, Certificate of Removal from Family Registry or closed Register, you can submit any documents such as certificate of birth, discharge, and death for proving Overseas Koreans with foreign citizenship or family relations
3. Documents demonstrating the reason for and an exact date of obtaining foreign citizenship such as passport of you and immediate family member, and a certificate proving the lineal descendant

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 2 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

passages.title: (Press Release) Visa Fee Waiver Policy for Group Tourists during the“2016 Visit Korea Year”
passages.file_name: 151221 PRESS RELEASE(Visa Fee Waiver Policy for Group Tourists).pdf
passages.snippet:
- 1 -
❍ The Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea extends the current visa fee waiver policy for group tourists through to the end of next year by reflecting the opinions of the tourism industry and relevant authorities.
Note: The Ministry has implemented visa fee wavier policy (effective from July 6, 2015 to Dec. 31, 2015) for group tourists from five countries (China, Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines and Cambodia) following the MERS outbreak.
❍ The number of Chinese tourists to Korea fell sharply in the wake of the MERS outbreak this year. While it has shown signs of recovery since August, it still remains around 74% of the last year’s arrivals.
❍ In proactive support of attracting group tourists for the “2016 Visit Korea Year”, the Ministry of Justice came to an agreement to extend the current visa fee* waiver policy for group tourists to the end of 2016. (*About USD 15 per person)
❍ The Ministry expects that the extended visa fee waiver policy would attract more group tourists from China and other countries and thereby significantly contribute to the revitalization of the Korean tourism industry and the economic recovery.

passages.snippet:

question: How many hours per week am I allowed to work on an H-1 working holiday visa?
reference: Not in the corpus. The H-1 guide only says the holder may take a short-term job to cover travel expenses; it gives no weekly hour limit.
answer: I could not find this in the visa.go.kr documents I have. Please check the Korea Visa Portal or ask the Korean embassy or consulate that handles your application.

passages.title: Visa guide: H-1 Working Holiday
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Citizen of a country that has signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) or other agreement in regards to Working Holidays policy, and plans to engage in a short-term job to cover travel expenses in Korea

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A citizen of a country that has signed a working holiday agreement or memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the Republic of Korea on the purpose of travel and finding a short-term employment to financially support yourself during the stay in ROK

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, one standard-size photograph, fee
※ Fee exempted for Citizens of France and Chile
② Round-trip ticket
③ Financial documents such as a Bank Account Balance Statement, which can prove that you are capable of supporting yourself during your stay in Korea for at least 3 months.
④ Travel Schedule and Activity Plan
⑤ Documents proving that you have a medical insurance that guarantees your return to your country and medical treatment during your stay in Korea (Exempted for Australia, United Kingdom)
⑥ Proof of enrollment or certificate of graduation from your final school (the principle of reciprocity will be applied.)
⑦ Criminal Records
- for Italy, Israel, Belgium, Taiwan, New Zealand, France, Ireland, Czech, Hungary, Netherlands only
⑧ Health Check-Up Results (the principle of reciprocity will be applied.)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: For a C-4 English camp language instructor (Embassy Case 3), how can the degree document be confirmed if it was issued in a country that has not signed the Apostille Convention?
reference: It can be confirmed by a consulate of that country's diplomatic mission in Korea. (The degree documents are also listed as authenticated by the Apostille Convention or by the consul of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad, so naming consular authentication by a Korean mission abroad is also acceptable.)
answer: If the document is issued from a country that is not a signatory country of the Apostille Convention, the document can be confirmed by a consulate of a respective country’s diplomatic mission in ROK [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: C-4 Short-Term Employee
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to visit for a short-term employment such as temporary show, advertising·modeling, lecturing·speeching, research, technology consulting, etc.

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who plans to work at a domestic company in a field of e-business (i.e. information technology, e-commerce), biotechnology, nanotechnology, advanced materials industry (metal, ceramics, and chemistry), transportation machinery, digital electronics, environment·energy, or technology management, and who have received an employment recommendation by the minister of respective department.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Employment Contract
③ Employment Recommendation Letter from the respective department (affiliated organizations)
④ Documents relevant to the establishment of institution (A copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of Corporate Register )

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year. Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A service provider who has been dispatched to the Republic of Korea based on a various services contract and who earns wages, including living expenses, from a government-owned company or a private corporation

※ Manual labor does not qualify for a Short-term Employee (C-4) visa.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of your service contract
③ A dispatch order or a proof of overseas assignment

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 months under the Visa Exemption Agreement between two countries.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

### Embassy visa application — Case 3

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

a language instructor at an English camp for less than 90 days.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A document verifying your degree (Choose one below)
- A copy of degree certificate (authenticated by the Apostille Convention or consul of Korean diplomatic missions abroad)
- A degree issued by a respective university (authenticated by the Apostille Convention or consul of Korean diplomatic missions abroad)
- A graduate certificate with degree conferred (authenticated by the Apostille Convention or consul of Korean diplomatic missions abroad)
※ If the document is issued from a country that is not a signatory country of the Apostille Convention, the document can be confirmed by a consulate of a respective country’s diplomatic mission in ROK.
③ Criminal Records (authenticated by the Apostille Convention or consul of Korean diplomatic missions abroad)
④ Employment Contract
⑤ A copy of Business Registration Certificate, a certified copy of Corporate Register or a document demonstrating the establishment of academic institutes
⑥ A certificate of continuing education registration or a document of report, receipt or designation regarding continuing education registration
⑦ Course or class schedule (indicate the hours of participation

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 months under the Visa Exemption Agreement between two countries.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

### Embassy visa application — Case 4

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who is applicable for a Professor(E-1) visa or a Foreign National of Special Ability (E-7) visa, and plans to give a lecture, give public speeches, or research for less than 90 days on the basis of a contract for profits as an expert in a particular area or a university instructor
※ If the lecturer or speaker is not compensated other than flight and accommodation, he/she is eligible for a Short-term General (C-3-1) visa.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An employment contract (on providing lectures·public speeches) or an invitation card that indicates lecture fees and others (a document of request for visa issuance cooperation)
③ A copy of degree certificate and proof of employment
④ A document related to the establishment of an inviting academic institution (a copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register and others)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 months under the Visa Exemption Agreement between two countries.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

### Embassy visa application — Case 5

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person staying in the Republic of Korea for less than 90 days, who plans to work for a short-run show, advertisement, fashion modeling or others for the purpose of making profits, or
A person who receives or will receive monetary compensation that is more than the living expenses and is other than cash prizes, in return for participating competitions on sports, Badook, or singing.

1) If you plan to perform in accordance with the Public Performance Act
2) If you plan to perform or engage in entertainment activities in hotel facilities or adult entertainment establishments, under the Tourism Promotion Act
3) If you receive or will receive monetary compensation exceeding his/her living expenses other than cash prizes in return for participating competitions on sports, Badook, or singing.
4) Other Cases

#### Required documents
1. Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
2. Additional documents for each case
Case 1) A recommendation letter from the Korea Media Rating Board (Some performances are exempt from submitting the letter), Performance Outline
Case 2) A performance recommendation letter by the Korea Media Rating Board, Entertainment activities outline, A certificate proving your qualification or experiences, A letter of guarantee
Case 3) An Invitation card or attendance confirmation issued by the host institution, A contract that indicates the wages/incentives for participating events (If such details are written on the invitation card, you do not have to submit the contract)
Case 4) An employment recommendation letter by the Minister of a respective department or a document proving the necessity of hiring**
* An employment recommendation letter from the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism for advertisement, fashion models and a recommendation letter from the Ministry of Science, ICT, and Future Planning
** An employment recommendation letter from respective athletic clubs (associations) for athletes, coaches, judges OR an official document requesting for a visa cooperation from the Minister of respective departments OR a document explaining the purposes and outlines of invitations/businesses OR a confirmation issuance from the host institution for participants in athletic, badook, and singing competitions which gives out cash prizes

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 months under the Visa Exemption Agreement between two countries.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

#### Required documents
1. Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
2. Additional documents for each case
Case 1) A recommendation letter from the Korea Media Rating Board (Some performances are exempt from submitting the letter), Performance Outline
Case 2) A performance recommendation letter by the Korea Media Rating Board, Entertainment activities outline, A certificate proving your qualification or experiences, A letter of guarantee
Case 3) An Invitation card or attendance confirmation issued by the host institution, A contract that indicates the wages/incentives for participating events (If such details are written on the invitation card, you do not have to submit the contract)
Case 4) An employment recommendation letter by the Minister of a respective department or a document proving the necessity of hiring**
* An employment recommendation letter from the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism for advertisement, fashion models and a recommendation letter from the Ministry of Science, ICT, and Future Planning
** An employment recommendation letter from respective athletic clubs (associations) for athletes, coaches, judges OR an official document requesting for a visa cooperation from the Minister of respective departments OR a document explaining the purposes and outlines of invitations/businesses OR a confirmation issuance from the host institution for participants in athletic, badook, and singing competitions which gives out cash prizes

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 months under the Visa Exemption Agreement between two countries.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

question: According to the investment guide for the real estate immigrant investor scheme, how often must the agents who sold the property check and report the investor's lease, mortgage, sale or foreclosure status to the Immigration Office?
reference: Every May and November.
answer: All agents who sell their real estate properties to others must check the lease status, mortgage, sale or foreclosure of their individual buyers and report to the Immigration Office every May and November [1, 2, 3, 4].

question: When an F-1-5 marriage immigrant invites a family member other than a parent, which additional documents are required?
reference: A document proving that both parents are unable to enter Korea, and a document showing the immediate family members of the invitee.
answer: When inviting family members other than parents, the additional documents required are a document proving both parents' inability to enter Korea, and a document showing the immediate family members of the invitee [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: F-1-5 결혼이민자본국가족
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Marriage immigrants’ parents, siblings, or children from a previous marriage residing in the home country of the immigrant

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you:

- are the father, mother, sibling, or child from a previous marriage of a marriage immigrant, and residing in the immigrant''s home country,
- intend to provide child-raising support (including pregnancy and birth) to the family of the marriage immigrant, or intend to stay with the family to provide humanitarian support (caring for critical illness or disability), and
- meet the requirements for the invitee, and the marriage immigrant also meets the requirement for the inviter, as detailed in the Guidelines for Issuing Visas to Parents and Other Family Members of Marriage Immigrants (F-1-5).

### Required documents
□ When Applying to Provide Child-raising Support
① Documents to Be Prepared by Inviter: copy of ID, Invitation Letter, Letter of Guarantee (guarantee period: 3 years from entry date), Pledge for Prevention of Illegal Stay or Employment, proof of residence (lease agreement, etc)
② Documents to Be Prepared by the Invitee: visa application form, passport, photo in a standard format, fee
③ Proof of Family Relation in Korea: Inviter’s Basic Certificate, Family Relation Certificate, Marriage Relation Certificate, copy of Resident Registration, Family Relation Certificate under the name of the inviter’s child (If the inviter is pregnant, Pregnancy Certificate or maternity note)
※ Inviters with two or more children must provide a Family Relation Certificate for each child.
④ Proof of Family Relation in Home Country: proof of family relation showing all immediate family members and siblings of the inviter (an official document issued by the government of the inviter’s home country)
※ When inviting family members other than parents, additional documents are required: a document proving both parents'' inability to enter Korea, and a document showing the immediate family members of the invitee.
⑤ For Inviters with School-Age Children: Certificate of Enrollment of the child

□ When Applying to Provide Humanitarian Support
①-④ Same documents as listed in ① to ④ above
⑤ Proof of Critical Illness or Disability: Certificate of Disability, Medical Expense Receipt indicating a critical illness (critical incurable illness) or eligibility for differential copayments

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days.
For more information on Foreign Resident Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

question: i got my re-entry permit in december 2020 and was exempted from the medical exam. im flying back to korea on january 15 2021. do i still need a covid PCR test?
reference: Yes. Foreigners whose re-entry permit was issued before January 8, 2021, including those exempted from medical examination, must also submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate if entering after 00:00 January 8, 2021.
answer: Foreigners with a Re-entry Permit (including those exempted from medical examination) issued before January 8 (Fri.), 2021 are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate if entering the nation after 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021 [1]. A negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate is deemed valid only when issued within 72 hours prior to departure [1].

citations.title: Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System
citations.file_name: Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System.pdf
citations.snippet:
【 Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System 】 This is to announce that Re-entry Permit System will change as specified below as all entrants from overseas are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate starting January 8 (Fri.), 2021 in response to recent spread of the highly transmissible new coronavirus strains.
□ Mandatory submission of negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate by foreigners issued with Re-entry Permit
• (Current) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR certificate, a medical certificate, or a medical examination exemption certificate.
• (After the Change) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate.
- A negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate is deemed valid only when issued within 72 hours prior to departure.
※ Application for ‘Medical Examination Exemption Certificate’ for Re-entry Permit is no longer available.
□ Date of Enforcement
• All foreigners entering the ROK are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate as of 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.
- Foreigners with a Re-entry Permit (including those exempted from medical examination) issued before January 8 (Fri.), 2021 are also required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate if entering the nation after 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.

passages.title: Visa guide: B-2-1 Tourist / Transit (General)
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Person who plans to visit Korea for tour or transit without a visa

#### Visa Free Entry Guide
Visa is a fundamental requirement to enter the Republic of Korea, and in principle, foreigners must have valid visas when they travel. However, those who fall under any of the following categories below are allowed to enter Korea without visas. (Article 7(2) of the Immigration Act)
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
Even if the foreigner has the valid visa or is subject to visa-free entry, he/she may be denied entry to the Republic of Korea if he's found inadmissible by an immigration officer at the port of entry.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)
### Visa Free Entry for Chinese Group Tourists with Japanese Group Tourist Visas (* Temporarily Suspended due to COVID-19)

#### 1. Eligible Applicants
Chinese group tourists with a Japanese group tourist visa who depart from China and transfer through Korea to visit Japan,
or who depart from Japan and transfer through Korea to visit China or a third country

#### 2. Condition of Permission
-
You are a Chinese tourist on a group tour organized by a Korean travel agency and a Chinese travel agency which applies for group tourist visas at a Korean mission in China. The list of group tourists must be submitted no later than 48 hours before entry into Korea and you must have a transfer ticket for a flight scheduled to depart within 15 days.
-
You can enter Korea through the Incheon, Gimpo, Gimhae, Daegu, Chengju, Yangyang, or Muan Airport (the Jeju Airport not included); and you can depart from Korea through the Jeju, Incheon, Gimpo, Gimhae, Daegu, Chengju, Yangyang, or Muan Airport.

passages.title: Visa guide: E-7-1 Professionals
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in a field designated by the Minister of Justice of ROK for the enhancement of national competitiveness by adopting foreign workers with professional knowledge/technology in accordance with a contract with a public or private institute in ROK

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A native administrative or technical staff of a diplomatic office, a cultural institute, or a foreign chamber of commerce in Korea

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Official documents from a foreign diplomatic mission in Korea requesting for cooperation
③ An employment contract
④ Documents proving the level of your education and career

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A crew member who promotes the convenience and safety of passenger on an international cruise which operates domestically. (i.e. Kumkang mountain cruise)

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Documents related to the establishment of a hiring company
③ An employment contract
④ A degree certificate or certificate of employment history
- including certificate of degree, certificate of career, resume, license

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

### Embassy visa application — Case 3

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A crew member who promotes the convenience and safety of passenger on an international cruise which operates domestically. (i.e. Kumkang mountain cruise)

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Documents related to the establishment of a hiring company
③ An employment contract
④ A degree certificate or certificate of employment history
- including certificate of degree, certificate of career, resume, license

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: On the Personal Details Form for an F-2-3 visa, what information must be given about children from previous marriages?
reference: The child's name, date of birth, nationality, and the person currently in charge of the child's custody.
answer: If the applicant has children from previous marriages, they must provide the child's name, date of birth, nationality, and the person charged with custody of the child [1].

passages.title: Visa guide: F-2-3 Spouse of permanent resident
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Spouse and a minor child of a permanent resident(F-5)

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A spouse of a Permanent Resident (F-5) visa holder

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An Invitation Letter(see Archives), Marriage Statement (see Archives)
③ Any relevant documents from both countries, which demonstrate the marital relationship
- Marriage certificate, certification of family relations records
④ Documents proving your funds and finance
⑤ Inviter's Proof of Residence
⑥ A letter of guarantee vouched by sponsor
⑦ Credit Reports of a sponsor
- It shall be issued by the Korean Foundation of Banks
⑧ Criminal Records of both parties that are married, which are issued by a responsible organization of respective country
⑨ Health check-up results of a married couple
- The document must be issued by a medical institution equivalent to a hospital as set forth in the 「Medical Service Act 」or the Local Health Act.
However, if you are a foreign spouse, you can submit similar documents issued from your country instead.
⑩ Any documents proving a dissolution of marriage if the applicant was married before (i.e. Divorce Certificate)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A minor child of a Permanent Resident(F-5) visa holder

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An invitation Letter
③ Documents proving that the applicant is a minor child of a sponsor(Permanent Resident)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: Under the April 2022 reimplementation of the re-entry permit exemption, what applies to persons banned from entering Korea or to whom visa issuance is prohibited?
reference: They are not eligible for the exemption. They need additional review procedures, their re-entry permit can be restricted, and they should inquire at an immigration office.
answer: Persons banned from entering Korea and persons to whom visa issuance is prohibited will need additional review procedures and re-entry permit can be restricted [1, 3].

passages.snippet:
- 1 - Announcement Regarding Re-Entry Permit Reimplementation of Re-Entry Permit Exemption as of April 1, 2022 after suspension due to COVID-19 The Re-Entry Permit Exemption which has been suspended since June 1, 2020 will be reimplemented as of April 1, 2022 according to changes in COVID response in the nation.
◎ With the re-implementation of the nation’s Re-Entry Permit Exemption, registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 will be allowed re-entry into the ROK within 1 year (2 years for permanent residents)
from the date of departure, without obtaining a Re-entry Permit in advance.
◎ Yet, registered foreign residents intending to re-enter the Republic of Korea after spending more than a year abroad from the date of departure should apply for a Multiple Re-entry Permit (granted for up to 2 years)
◎ Registered foreigners who have departed before April 1, 2022 with a Re-entry Permit should enter the ROK within the granted re-entry permit period (within l year), and should visit a Korean diplomatic mission abroad to extend the re-entry permit period in case entering the ROK within the relevant period is difficult due to COVID-19.

Visa is a fundamental requirement to enter the Republic of Korea, and in principle, foreigners must have valid visas when they travel. However, those who fall under any of the following categories below are allowed to enter Korea without visas. (Article 7(2) of the Immigration Act)

passages.title: Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System
passages.file_name: Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System.pdf
passages.snippet:
【 Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System 】 This is to announce that Re-entry Permit System will change as specified below as all entrants from overseas are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate starting January 8 (Fri.), 2021 in response to recent spread of the highly transmissible new coronavirus strains.
□ Mandatory submission of negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate by foreigners issued with Re-entry Permit
• (Current) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR certificate, a medical certificate, or a medical examination exemption certificate.
• (After the Change) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate.
- A negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate is deemed valid only when issued within 72 hours prior to departure.
※ Application for ‘Medical Examination Exemption Certificate’ for Re-entry Permit is no longer available.
□ Date of Enforcement
• All foreigners entering the ROK are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate as of 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.
- Foreigners with a Re-entry Permit (including those exempted from medical examination) issued before January 8 (Fri.), 2021 are also required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate if entering the nation after 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.

passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Spouse and a minor child of a permanent resident(F-5)

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A spouse of a Permanent Resident (F-5) visa holder

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An Invitation Letter(see Archives), Marriage Statement (see Archives)
③ Any relevant documents from both countries, which demonstrate the marital relationship
- Marriage certificate, certification of family relations records
④ Documents proving your funds and finance
⑤ Inviter's Proof of Residence
⑥ A letter of guarantee vouched by sponsor
⑦ Credit Reports of a sponsor
- It shall be issued by the Korean Foundation of Banks
⑧ Criminal Records of both parties that are married, which are issued by a responsible organization of respective country
⑨ Health check-up results of a married couple
- The document must be issued by a medical institution equivalent to a hospital as set forth in the 「Medical Service Act 」or the Local Health Act.
However, if you are a foreign spouse, you can submit similar documents issued from your country instead.
⑩ Any documents proving a dissolution of marriage if the applicant was married before (i.e. Divorce Certificate)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.

passages.snippet:
<붙임2>
(제1쪽 / Page1)
결혼 배경 진술서 (Personal Details Form for F-2-3 Visa)
<유의사항>
이 질문지는 영주자격 소지자의 배우자(F-2-3) 사증발급 또는 체류자격 변경허가를 신청하는 신청인이 작성합니다. 원칙적으로 이 서류에 기재된 정보에 따라 심사가 진행되니 신청인께서는 가능한 모든 질문에 답변하고, 영사 및 출입국관리공무원이 심사 시 참고할 수 있도록 답변과 관련된 입증서류가 있는 경우 모두 제출하시기 바랍니다. 답변이 누락되거나 입증서류가 제출되지 않는 경 우 심사가 지연되거나 불허될 수 있습니다.
만약 허가에 필요한 요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건입증에 필요한 서류를 갖추지 못하였음에도 요건을 충족한 것으로 보이기 위해 허위의 사실을 기재하거나 위조된 서류를 제출하는 것은 관련 법령에 의거 처벌될 뿐만 아니라, 한국 입국이 금지될 수 있습니다.
요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건을 입증하는 서류를 갖추지 못하였다면, 그 사유를 기재한 사유서를 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.
귀하가 제공하신 정보는 개인정보 보호법에 따라 보호되며, 다른 법령에 근거가 없는 한 출입국관리법에 따른 업무에만 활용됩니다.
<NOTE>
This form is to be completed by a person applying for a marriage visa(F-2-3). In principle, the evaluation of the visa application will be based on the information provided on this personal details form. Therefore, the questions must be answered to the best of the applicant's knowledge and submit any relevant documentation that can be provided to the consul or the immigration officer as reference. If a necessary answer has been omitted or any relevant documentation has not been submitted, the evaluation process for the application may be delayed or disapproved.
If conditions are not met for the visa or if falsified information and/or documentation are forged to meet the conditions required to receive the visa, you will be not only penalized under the relevant Act but also banned from entering the Republic of Korea. If you are unable to provide proper documentation, submit a statement stating the reason.

question: Which levels of education can be ticked as the highest completed level on the Korean Visa Application Form?
reference: Master's/Doctoral Degree, Bachelor's Degree, High School Diploma, or Other (with details).
answer: The highest degree or level of education the applicant has completed can be ticked as Master’s /Doctoral Degree, Bachelor’s Degree, High School Diploma, or Other [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].

reference: Not in the corpus. No vaccination certificate is required anywhere. The Health & Mentality Statement only asks about past infectious diseases (syphilis, viral hepatitis B, tuberculosis), drugs or alcohol, mental disorders and serious illnesses. The closest requirement is a February 2016 notice: nationals of listed high TB-burden countries who live in one of those countries and apply at a Korean mission for a long-term visa (91 days or longer) must submit a TB test certificate (a 'Certificate of Health' from a designated hospital). That is a TB test, not a vaccination.
answer: Applicants for E-9, E-10, and H-2 visas must submit a medical examination certificate obtained from designated hospitals by the Korean government when registering as a foreigner within 90 days of arrival in Korea if they wish to stay longer than 90 days [1]. Additionally, these visa holders who already submitted a certificate including a TB test result when applying for alien registration on or after March 2, 2016, are exempt from further submission [2].

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who meets the domestic employment requirements under the provision in the Act on the Employment of Foreign Workers and is employed in metal mining, non-metallic mineral mining, etc

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who meets employment requirements in accordance with the provisions of the Act on Foreign Workers' Employment, who plans to work for a manufacturer with less than 300 full-time workers or capital worth less than 8 billion KRW.

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A copy of Business Registration Certificate
③ A copy of Employment Permit and a copy of Standard Labor Contract
④ A report of workplace assessment

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

<유의사항>
‣ 이 진술서는 결혼동거 목적의 사증발급 또는 체류자격 변경허가를 받으려는 해당 외국인(신청인)이 작성합니다.
‣ 원칙적으로 이 서류에 기재된 정보에 따라 심사가 진행되니 영사 및 출입국관리공무원이 심사에 참고할 수 있도록 신청인께서는 해당하는 모든 질문에 답변하시고, 답변과 관련된 입증서류가 있는 경우 모두 제출하시기 바랍니다.
‣ 해당하는 답변을 누락하거나 입증서류를 제출하지 않은 경우에는 심사가 지연되거나 불허될 수 있습니다.
‣ 만약 사증발급이나 체류자격 변경허가에 필요한 요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건을 입증하는 서류가 없음에도 거 짓된 사실을 기재하거나 위ㆍ변조된 서류를 제출하는 경우에는 관련 법령에 따라 처벌될 뿐만 아니라, 한국 입 국이 금지될 수 있습니다.

‣ 귀하께서 제공한 정보는 「개인정보 보호법」에 따라 보호되며, 다른 법령에 근거가 없는 한 출입국관리법에 따 른 업무에만 활용됩니다. <NOTICE>
